items.title: SpaceX Joins Nasdaq-100 on July 7 in Fastest Major Index Inclusion After IPO
items.summary: SpaceX (SPCX) entered Nasdaq-100 just 15 trading days after its June 12 IPO at $135/share and $1.75T valuation, enabled by Nasdaq's revised fast-entry rules. QQQ/QQQM forced to buy; S&P 500 inclusion requires profitability not met until at least mid-2027.
items.why: SpaceX入Nasdaq-100将触发ETF大规模被动买入，压缩指数内其他权重股空间；同时确认科技/国防AI赛道持续吸引巨额资金。

items.title: Tencent Sells $1.5B Kuaishou Stake While BAT Alliance Pours $2.8B into Kling AI at $18B Valuation
items.summary: Tencent sold ~273M Kuaishou shares via block trade (stake cut to 9.37%), raising HK$10B+. Simultaneously, Tencent, Alibaba, and Baidu joined 36 investors in a $2.8B round for Kuaishou's Kling AI spin-off at $18B post-money valuation to counter ByteDance. Kling AI ARR now $500M.
items.why: 腾讯减持快手反映持续降低非核心权益，同时联合BAT共投Kling AI体现AI视频生成战略布局；后者若成功出圈将为腾讯生态带来AI协同价值，亦体现其AI赛道防御姿态。

items.title: US June Payrolls Miss Badly: Only 57,000 Jobs Added vs. 115,000 Forecast
items.summary: Weakest monthly payroll gain in months, with April-May revised down by a combined 74,000. Unemployment fell to 4.2% due to a drop in labor force participation rate to 61.5%, the lowest since March 2021. Rate hike odds sharply reduced.
items.why: 就业大幅不及预期令市场加息预期降温，对风险资产短期利好，但整体经济走弱信号值得关注，sell put策略行权风险下降。

items.title: Fed June FOMC Minutes Signal Hawkish Shift; 9 Officials Project Rate Hike in 2026
items.summary: Minutes released July 8 show Fed removed earlier hints of rate cuts and shifted focus to persistent inflation. Nine members project at least one hike in 2026; core PCE forecast raised to 3.3%. Market-implied odds of July 29 hike at ~20%.
items.why: 联储会议纪要鹰派超预期，利率维持3.50-3.75%不变但加息预期重燃，直接影响sell put策略的期权隐含波动率定价与市场风险偏好。

items.title: Alibaba Agrees to $600M DOJ Non-Prosecution Deal Over Illegal Drug Marketplace Sales; Stock Surges 11%
items.summary: Alibaba and Ant Group unit AUS Merchant Services will pay $600M to resolve 8-year DOJ probe: $125M criminal penalty + $200M forfeiture (BABA), $85M + $190M (AUS). Non-prosecution agreement means no conviction. BABA stock jumped 11.06% on July 8.
items.why: 法律悬顶正式落地为可计算成本（而非开放性不确定性），解除对美国合规业务的影响，利好BABA估值重估；期权卖方可关注IV回落后sell put机会。

items.title: Futu Holdings Hit With RMB1.85B (~$271M) CSRC Penalty for Unlicensed Mainland Business; Stock Fell 27%
items.summary: China's CSRC proposed to confiscate illegal proceeds and impose fines totaling RMB1.85B on Futu entities for conducting securities, fund sales, and futures business in mainland China without required licenses. CEO Li Hua faces RMB1.25M personal fine. Multiple securities class-action lawsuits filed.
items.why: 富途遭重罚暴露在中国境内无证经营风险，股价已跌逾27%；若持有FUTU期权，需评估IV和行权价风险；该罚款为历史性监管风险，对互联网券商赛道构成系统性负面影响。

items.title: Oil Surges Over 5% as US-Iran Tensions Reignite; Trump Declares Ceasefire 'Over'
items.summary: WTI crude surged to ~$74/bbl and Brent to ~$77.7 on Wednesday July 8 after President Trump declared the interim Iran ceasefire 'over' and threatened new blockades on Hormuz. Energy sector outperformed; inflation expectations reset upward, weighing on growth stocks.
items.why: 油价急涨强化通胀预期，对联储鹰派信号构成叠加效应，压制成长股估值；同时能源板块短期受益，需关注对持仓科技/消费股的情绪传导。

items.title: SK Hynix Lists on Nasdaq July 10 (SKHY) in Record $29B Foreign Company ADR Offering
items.summary: SK Hynix will debut on Nasdaq tomorrow, raising up to ~$29B — largest-ever U.S. listing by a foreign firm. Proceeds fund Yongin Cluster fab (₩31T), advanced HBM packaging (₩19T), and EUV equipment. Hynix holds 56.4% global HBM revenue share as of Q1 2026.
items.why: SK海力士ADR上市将大幅提升HBM板块在美资本市场能见度，同时冲击对持有CSOP南方两倍做多SK海力士ETF的投资者；明日上市需关注定价区间和开盘溢价。

items.title: Tesla Robotaxi Expands to Miami; Q2 Deliveries Beat at ~480K; NHTSA Closes FSD Safety Probe
items.summary: Tesla launched driverless Robotaxi service in Miami on July 3 — first city outside Texas/California. Q2 deliveries ~480,000 beat highest estimates by 60,000+; energy storage hit 13.5 GWh. NHTSA closed Model 3/Y unexpected braking investigation following software fixes.
items.why: Robotaxi扩城+Q2交付超预期是TSLA中期核心催化剂，FSD安全调查关闭降低监管风险；持有TSLA的投资者可关注7月22日Q2财报是否进一步确认盈利能力。

items.title: Apple Supplier Luxshare Slips Over 5% in Hong Kong Debut After Record HK$24.3B IPO
items.summary: Luxshare Precision (Apple AirPods/iPhone assembler) fell as much as 9.6% on first day July 9, trading near HK$60 vs. IPO price HK$63.28 — the top of its range. The deal was HK's largest listing of 2026 (US$3.1B), backed by Temasek and GIC.
items.why: 港股最大IPO首日破发，反映港股申购资金流失和投资者短期抛售压力，可观察港股市场IPO吸引力与整体流动性；与持仓个股无直接关联，但影响大盘情绪。

items.title: Xiaomi Unveils 'Sky Nomad' EREV SUV Series (Pengcheng), Enters Extended-Range EV Market
items.summary: CEO Lei Jun announced Xiaomi's new Pengcheng (澎城) SUV series on July 9, branded 'Sky Nomad,' pitching 'smart, versatile, spacious' SUVs as Chinese alternative to Tesla Model Y. EREV uses combustion engine as range extender. YU7 has delivered 258,232 units since June 2025 launch.
items.why: 小米今日发布全新增程SUV，进一步丰富汽车产品矩阵，正面迎战特斯拉；新品能否获取订单将验证汽车业务增量空间，影响1810.HK中期估值逻辑。

items.title: Gold Retreats to $4,050 on Middle East Flare-Up and Revived Hike Fears After Touching $4,200
items.summary: Spot gold fell over 1% to $4,050/oz on July 8 — monthly low — as oil surge reignited inflation fears and hawkish Fed signals dampened rate-cut hopes. Gold had rallied above $4,100 after the June payroll miss but reversed on geopolitical escalation.
items.why: 金价高位回调压制老铺黄金（6181.HK）等黄金概念股短期情绪；同时高通胀维持令Fed降息时间表延后，宏观背景偏不利于长久期资产。

items.title: Circle (CRCL) Faces July 18 GENIUS Act Compliance Deadline; Fed Rules Imminent for USDC Issuers
items.summary: The GENIUS Act's one-year transition expires July 18, with Fed/Treasury required to release stablecoin issuer rules. Stricter reserve, capital, or licensing standards could impact USDC issuer Circle. CRCL stock fell ~2.8% on July 8 amid geopolitical risk aversion.
items.why: GENIUS法案落地将正式确立Circle USDC的监管框架，规则宽严直接影响CRCL盈利结构；7月18日前后为关键催化时间窗口，卖期权者需注意事件驱动IV波动。

items.title: Nvidia Refutes Kyber NVL144 Delay; Goldman Sees 21.7x PE as 'Compelling' Near S&P Average
items.summary: NVDA shares gained 1%+ after the company denied reports that its Kyber NVL144 AI system would be delayed to 2028. Goldman Sachs analyst flagged NVDA's 21.7x forward P/E is near S&P 500 average and well below its 5-year average of 72x. $119B in supply commitments secured.
items.why: 英伟达主动否认产品延迟稳定市场信心；高盛低估值论点若被市场接受，可能推动NVDA估值重估；持有或计划sell put NVDA者可关注Q2财报（预计8月）验证数据中心需求。

items.title: Temu Owner PDD Hit by Government Raids in Ireland and China Over Alleged Subsidy Fraud
items.summary: Investigators raided Temu/Pinduoduo (PDD) facilities in Ireland and Shanghai probing alleged subsidy fraud. The US has formally eliminated the de minimis exemption, eroding Temu's cost advantage. PDD Q1 2026 revenue grew 11% YoY to RMB106.2B but faces dual margin headwinds.
items.why: Temu遭双管齐下（补贴欺诈调查+de minimis取消），进一步压制跨境电商利润率；若调查深化将对PDD估值构成重大负面影响，持有或卖put PDD需高度警惕。

items.title: SanDisk (SNDK) Q3 Revenue Surges 251% YoY to $6B; Gross Margin at 78.4%; Best S&P 500 Performer H1 2026
items.summary: SanDisk reported record Q3 revenue of $6B (+251% YoY) with gross margin of 78.4% as AI-driven NAND demand tightened supply globally. Company began sampling BiCS10 1Tb TLC NAND on July 2. Stock was the top S&P 500 performer in H1 2026. Next earnings: Aug 24.
items.why: SanDisk NAND业绩超预期印证AI算力基础设施对存储的强劲需求，间接利好美光（MU）和SK海力士的DRAM/HBM估值逻辑；可关注SNDK是否为sell put标的。

items.title: Walmart and Sam's Club Launch Major Summer Price Cuts Across Thousands of Items
items.summary: Walmart and Sam's Club announced thousands of summer rollbacks on beef, produce, beverages, grills, pools, toys, and apparel. Sam's Club Q1 e-commerce sales +23% YoY with club-fulfilled delivery +90%. Move driven by consumer price sensitivity amid elevated inflation.
items.why: 沃尔玛大规模降价是应对消费者价格敏感度上升的战略举措，表明零售端价格压力持续；山姆电商高增长支撑中期估值，但降价策略可能短期压缩毛利率。

items.title: 美联储6月维持利率不变但鹰派分歧扩大：9位官员预计年内至少加息一次，PCE通胀预测上调至3.6%
items.summary: 美联储6月会议维持联邦基金利率在3.5-3.75%目标区间不变，但FOMC内部分化明显：9位官员预计年内至少加息一次（其中6位预计加息两次），年终利率预测中枢上调至3.6-4.1%；PCE通胀全年预测从2.7%大幅上调至3.6%，主因伊朗战争推高能源价格。下次FOMC会议7月28-29日召开。
items.why: 加息预期升温持续压制成长股估值倍数；卖出看跌期权时行权价需预留更大安全边际，隐含波动率上升有利于期权金收入但需管控gamma风险；7月29日FOMC是下一个关键催化剂。

items.title: 美国对伊朗发动80余次空袭并重新制裁石油出口，布伦特原油大涨，特朗普宣布停火谅解备忘录「已作废」
items.summary: 美国军方中央司令部7月7-8日对伊朗80余处目标实施空袭，随后特朗普在北约峰会上宣布此前停火谅解备忘录「已作废」；与此同时美国重新对伊朗石油出口制裁生效，布伦特原油大幅上涨至约78美元/桶；伊朗随即反击美国在科威特和巴林军事基地。
items.why: 地缘冲突再度升级推高能源通胀压力，与美联储加息预期共振，科技/消费成长股估值承压；sell put策略需关注隐含波动率骤升风险，建议在相关标的上拉开安全边际。

items.title: 路透社独家：DeepSeek正在自研AI推理芯片，接触晶圆代工及存储伙伴，目标减少对英伟达和华为芯片依赖
items.summary: 彭博7月7日转引路透社独家报道：DeepSeek正与多家芯片设计、晶圆代工及存储公司洽谈，研发专用AI推理芯片，已秘密招募芯片工程师约一年，目前仍处早期阶段；旨在降低对英伟达及华为硬件的依赖。OpenAI上月已发布自研推理芯片Jalapeno（联合Broadcom），Anthropic亦在考虑自研。
items.why: 若属实，长期将冲击英伟达中国推理市场份额；短期为单一未经官方确认的独家消息，不宜过度交易；对美光/SK海力士HBM供应影响暂时中性，需跟踪。

items.title: SK Hynix hits Nasdaq July 10 under ticker SKHY in largest-ever ADR offering (~$29B); 2x ETFs SKUU/SKDD launch July 13
items.summary: SK Hynix will list on Nasdaq on July 10, 2026 under ticker SKHY, raising up to ~$29 billion — the largest ADR offering in Wall Street history. SK Hynix commands 50-70% of the global HBM market. Two leveraged tracking ETFs — SKUU (2x long) and SKDD (2x short) — are expected to debut July 13.
items.why: SK海力士ADR上市消除韩国折价，国际机构配置通道打开；持有CSOP南方两倍做多SK海力士ETF的投资者需注意7月10日上市后底层资产溢价可能压缩，是套利观察窗口。

items.title: 阿里巴巴宣布合并三款企业AI Agent产品为统一平台，9988.HK当日涨幅显著
items.summary: 阿里巴巴宣布将旗下三款企业级AI Agent产品——QoderWork、悟空（Wukong）、MuleRun——整合为统一企业AI生产力平台，由钉钉CEO陈宇森主导；通义实验室同步升级为事业部，吴泳铭亲自挂帅新技术委员会。消息公布后9988.HK当日出现大幅涨升，为近数月最大单日涨幅。
items.why: AI企业应用整合减少内部资源分散，有助于阿里云在B端AI赛道加速变现；叠加此前较低估值，有估值重估空间；持有9988.HK的sell put可考虑适当上移行权价。

items.title: 腾讯以大宗交易减持快手逾百亿港元至约9.37%，同期联合阿里百度参与Kling AI约28亿美元融资
items.summary: Bloomberg报道腾讯通过场外大宗交易出售约2.73亿股快手股份，套现逾百亿港元，持仓降至约9.37%；与此同时腾讯以约2亿美元参与快手旗下Kling AI约28亿美元融资（估值约180亿美元），BAT联合38家机构押注Kling AI以制衡字节跳动。
items.why: 腾讯出售快手权益套现后把资金导向AI视频投资，资本配置效率改善；0700.HK持有人可维持较高信心，卖出看跌期权逻辑未变。

items.title: 宇树科技科创板IPO获证监会注册批文，创104天最快审核纪录，预计7月中下旬上市成A股人形机器人第一股
items.summary: 宇树科技（全球四足/人形机器人头部企业）科创板IPO于7月1日获证监会注册批文（证监许可〔2026〕1612号），从申报到注册仅历时104天，创科创板最快纪录；计划募资约420亿元，预计7月中下旬正式上市。2023-2025年营收CAGR约226%，2025年non-GAAP净利润约5.91亿元。
items.why: 宇树上市将为A股机器人赛道提供估值锚，可能带动机器人主题ETF及产业链重新定价，关注上市初期溢价与波动机会。

items.title: 小米汽车6月交付量同比增约36%，YU7 SUV上半年累计交付突破10万辆，1810.HK股价明显走强
items.summary: 小米汽车7月8日披露6月交付量同比增长约36%至34,738辆，YU7 SUV上半年累计交付突破10万辆；受强劲数据提振，1810.HK当日股价明显走高。YU7当前预计等待周期已从上市初期逾一年大幅压缩至数周。
items.why: 交付量持续高增验证小米汽车放量逻辑，YU7需求强劲有利于全年目标达成；下半年逐月交付数据是持仓管理核心跟踪指标。

items.title: 消息称北京考虑允许阿里、字节、DeepSeek等顶尖中国AI公司有限购买英伟达H200芯片，NVDA当日明显走高
items.summary: 市场消息称北京正在考虑允许国内顶尖AI公司（含阿里云、字节跳动、DeepSeek）有限量购买英伟达H200高性能GPU；英伟达股价7月8日应声明显走高。该消息尚未得到官方确认。
items.why: H200解禁若落实将大幅扩大英伟达中国可寻址市场，是持有NVDA sell put的正面信号；但属未经证实消息，需等待官方渠道确认后再调整期权行权价判断。

items.title: 英特尔股价7月以来累跌逾20%：18A制程盈利良率延期至2026年底、AMD数据中心收入首超英特尔，7月23日财报为关键
items.summary: 英特尔股价7月以来大幅下挫，三重利空叠加：①18A先进制程盈利良率延迟至2026年底至2027年（18A-P已进入风险量产阶段，但规模化良率仍存疑）；②AMD Q1数据中心收入（约58亿美元）首次超过英特尔（约51亿美元）；③AI芯片板块整体承压。7月23日Q2财报是关键节点。
items.why: 英特尔代工赛道叙事受质疑，财报前不确定性高；半导体板块整体波动率上升，影响美光/SK海力士相关期权定价；如持有INTC，建议财报前管控风险敞口。

items.title: US Revokes Iran Oil Waiver After Tanker Attacks, Launches New Strikes on 80+ Targets
items.summary: The US struck over 80 Iranian sites (air defense, IRGC boats, coastal radar) and revoked Iran's oil sales license after two tankers — Qatari LNG tanker Al Rekayat and Saudi supertanker Wedyan — were struck in the Strait of Hormuz on July 7. Brent crude settled +3% at $74.16/bbl; after-hours extended to $76.04 (+5.6%) when sanctions were reimposed. WTI rose to $72.25 (+5.4%).
items.why: 最重大地缘冲击：霍尔木兹海峡局势升级+伊朗石油制裁重启，推高油价与全球通胀预期，进一步压缩降息空间；高估值成长股承压，油服板块受益；能源通胀加剧令美联储更难偏鸽

items.title: Samsung Q2 2026: Operating Profit Surges 19x YoY — Yet Triggers Global Memory Stock Selloff
items.summary: Samsung Q2 preliminary operating profit reached ~89.4 trillion won (+19x YoY), revenue roughly doubled — yet Samsung stock fell ~6-7%, SK Hynix ~6%, Micron/SanDisk/Western Digital dropped ~7% on July 7. Markets are worried about AI capex sustainability, HBM margin durability, and potential DRAM/HBM oversupply risk in H2 2026.
items.why: 直接影响持仓美光(MU)、闪迪(SNDK)、SK海力士：存储超周期估值受严峻考验；Samsung抛售后是重新评估 sell put 行权价与保证金缓冲的关键时刻

items.title: Alibaba 9988.HK: Court Grants Lobbying Reprieve on Pentagon Blacklist; $600M DOJ Settlement Reached
items.summary: US District Judge Eumi K. Lee ordered the Pentagon to suspend treating Alibaba as a 'Chinese military company' for lobbying-ban purposes (1260H designation added June 8), pending court review. Separately, Alibaba and AUS Merchant Services agreed to pay $600M total to resolve DOJ illegal pharmaceutical sales allegations — Alibaba's share: $125M criminal penalty + $200M forfeiture.
items.why: 两大关键法律风险阶段性化解：法院保护令暂停Pentagon名单效力；DOJ和解金额$600M对阿里财务影响有限；股价有望修复前期压制，是重新评估持仓的关键窗口

items.title: 腾讯正式发布混元3.0（Hy3）：295B参数开源MoE模型，全面集成微信/元宝/WorkBuddy（7月6日）
items.summary: 腾讯7月6日发布Hy3（混元3.0），295B总参数MoE架构，激活参数21B，支持256K上下文，幻觉率从12.5%降至5.4%，Apache 2.0可商用开源。集成至微信AI助手、元宝App、WorkBuddy，日均token消费量月增20倍。中金维持跑赢评级，目标价HK$666。同日回购46.5万股耗资HK$2.048亿。
items.why: AI落地超预期且有规模证明（token消费20倍增），是估值重估重要催化；开源策略有助构建生态；回购信号积极；0700.HK sell put 策略溢价有望受益
items.source: 财新全球 / 腾讯官方

items.title: Circle CRCL: 140-Firm Consortium (Visa, Mastercard, Google, BlackRock) Announces Open USD to Challenge USDC; Stock Fell 16%
items.summary: On June 30, 2026, Open Standard — a 140-company consortium including Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Stripe, BlackRock, Coinbase, Google, and BNY — announced Open USD stablecoin: fully reserved, zero mint/redeem fees, distributes nearly all reserve earnings to member firms rather than a single issuer. Circle (CRCL) fell 16% to $63.85 on the day. USDC commands $78B in circulation; Circle generates 95.5% of H1 2026 revenue from reserve interest.
items.why: USDC商业模式（利息收入95%）面临结构性威胁；140家巨头联合体量压倒性，Circle持仓者需重估竞争格局；高隐含波动率下 sell put 需保守行权价

items.title: Tesla TSLA: Q2 Deliveries 480,126 Units (+25% YoY); Robotaxi Expands to Miami; Optimus Production Starts July; Q2 Earnings July 22
items.summary: Tesla reported Q2 2026 global deliveries of 480,126 vehicles (+25% YoY). On July 3, fully unsupervised Robotaxi service (no safety driver) expanded to western Miami-Dade — now covering Austin, Dallas, Houston, and Miami. Optimus humanoid robot production begins July 2026. Musk targets Robotaxi in a dozen+ states by year-end. Q2 2026 financial results due July 22.
items.why: Q2交付超预期+Robotaxi多城扩张+Optimus量产：三重催化强化成长叙事；7月22日财报前隐含波动率升高，是 sell put 关注窗口
items.source: Motley Fool / Basenor / Globe and Mail

items.title: Fed Holds at 3.63%; July 28-29 FOMC Expected Unchanged; Futures Price Rate Path to 3.8-4% by Year-End
items.summary: The Federal Reserve maintained the effective fed funds rate at 3.63% after its June 2026 decision, with inflation still above 2%. The July 28-29 FOMC meeting is expected to hold rates unchanged. Futures markets price a path rising to ~3.8% by October and approaching 4% by year-end 2026 — a higher-for-longer stance.
items.why: 高利率持续压制成长股估值折现；利率路径上修风险令期权 sell put 权利金吸引力下降；7月29日FOMC是最近关键观察点

items.title: Gold Falls $49 on Iran-Hormuz Strike — Inflation Fear Trumps Safe-Haven Demand
items.summary: Gold fell from $4,165 to an intraday low of $4,116 (-1.1%) on July 7 as tanker attacks in the Strait of Hormuz sparked oil inflation fears rather than safe-haven demand. A Hormuz-driven oil spike stokes inflation, keeps the Fed hawkish, elevates real yields, and pressures gold — the market's counter-intuitive but logical reaction in the 2026 higher-for-longer environment.
items.why: 黄金避险属性弱化背后是能源通胀加剧Fed鹰派逻辑：实际利率走高是黄金的持续逆风；持有老铺黄金(6181.HK)者需关注金价走势对业绩影响

items.title: 7月8日A股：美伊局势推高油服板块，上证指数承压；市场整体调整
items.summary: 7月8日A股市场整体承压，上证指数受压调整，美伊开战推高国际油价令油服概念板块活跃，成为为数不多的反弹主线。沪深北三所新版交易规则6日施行后市场进入适应期，成交量有所收窄，科技主线小幅反弹，房地产等板块继续承压。
items.why: A股短期受伊朗地缘因素影响有限，但油价上升可能传导至下游通胀，并影响货币政策预期；油服、能源类板块的阶段性交易机会

items.title: 泡泡玛特 Labubu 亮相FIFA 2026世界杯开幕式，成首个登上世界杯官方MV的艺术玩具IP
items.summary: 6月12日，两只泡泡玛特Labubu巨型公仔作为特别嘉宾出现在2026 FIFA世界杯开幕式球场，并首登世界杯官方主题MV。此前3月29日官宣与FIFA合作推出The Monsters x FIFA限定系列（盲盒、毛绒、配件），在北美、墨西哥举办地同步销售。
items.why: Labubu全球品牌破圈至史上最高规格体育IP；世界杯期间持续全球曝光，有望刺激海外销售与品牌认知，是9992.HK估值重估正面催化

items.title: 美团开源 LongCat-2.0：1.6T参数MoE，行业首次在5万卡国产ASIC集群完成训练，SWE-Bench超GPT-5.5
items.summary: 美团6月30日正式开源 LongCat-2.0（1.6T总参数MoE，激活约48B，支持1M上下文），MIT许可证，完全使用国产ASIC算力（5万卡）完成全量训练推理，全球首例。此前以别名Owl Alpha霸榜OpenRouter全球开发者榜两个月。SWE-Bench Pro得分59.5，超GPT-5.5的58.6。
items.why: 美团AI技术实力超预期且有国产算力突破，有助重估3690.HK科技溢价；开源MIT许可证加速商业化落地；国产算力突破具政策信号价值

items.title: Nvidia NVDA: Blackwell Ultra GA for Agentic AI (20x More Agents/Megawatt vs Hopper); Data Center Revenue +92% YoY
items.summary: Nvidia's Blackwell Ultra (GB300 NVL72: 72 GPUs + 36 Grace CPUs, rack-scale) is now generally available for agentic AI workloads, delivering 20x more agents per megawatt vs Hopper. Anthropic Claude on Microsoft Azure running on Nvidia GB300 Blackwell Ultra is now GA. Recent quarterly results: revenue $81.6B (+85% YoY), data center $75.2B (+92% YoY). Jensen Huang: 'Agentic AI has arrived, doing productive work.'
items.why: AI基础设施需求持续超预期，Nvidia护城河加深；Blackwell Ultra扩大对HBM4的长期需求，利好SK海力士/美光持仓；NVDA自身期权策略基本面背景持续改善

items.title: Micron MU: Record Q3 FY2026 Revenue $41.46B (+346% YoY); HBM4 Ramping 2x Pace; 16 Take-or-Pay SCAs Signed
items.summary: Micron Q3 FY2026 (reported June 24): revenue $41.46B (+346% YoY, +74% QoQ), non-GAAP gross margin 84.9%, diluted EPS $25.11. HBM4 shipments for Nvidia Vera Rubin began March 2026, ramping at ~2x the pace of HBM3E, yield ahead of expectations. Signed 16 Strategic Customer Agreements (SCAs) with take-or-pay terms, $22B+ in commitments covering up to 50% of future revenue.
items.why: 历史性业绩叠加SCAs锁定长期需求；Samsung earnings引发的抛售是重新评估 sell put 进场点的机会，SCAs锁定基本面下行保护

items.title: SK Hynix 2026 HBM Outlook: Leads Market at 50-55% Share; HBM3E Covers ~2/3 of 2026 Shipments; HBM4 Ramping
items.summary: SK Hynix expects HBM to fuel the AI memory supercycle through 2026, commanding 50-55% market share. HBM3E is expected to account for approximately two-thirds of total 2026 HBM shipments; HBM4 gradually increases share in H2. SK Hynix has been building new packaging plants and ramping fabs to meet demand. Stock fell ~6% on July 7 amid Samsung earnings-triggered memory selloff.
items.why: HBM市场领导地位稳固，但Samsung财报引发的抛售拖累7709.HK；HBM定价韧性和客户需求是 sell put 策略核心观察指标

items.title: SanDisk SNDK: Stock Falls ~14% in Memory Selloff; Up ~487% YTD; BiCS10 10th-Gen NAND Production Begins With Kioxia
items.summary: SanDisk (SNDK) fell approximately 14% in a single session on July 6, pulling back from all-time highs — still up ~487% year-to-date. Selloff trigger was Meta announcing it would sell spare AI compute capacity externally, easing AI compute shortage fears. Simultaneously, SanDisk began BiCS10 (10th-gen NAND) production with Kioxia in Japan, sampling 1Tb BiCS10 TLC chips for AI data-center storage.
items.why: 持仓闪迪者：大幅回调中检查 covered call 期权情况；BiCS10量产是长期利好，短期抛售属情绪驱动，基本面无恶化——是 sell put 评估机会

items.title: Intel INTC: 18A-P Production Starts; Profitable Yields Delayed to Late 2026/2027; Q1 Foundry External Rev Only $174M; Q2 Earnings July 23
items.summary: Intel began production of its 18A-P process node (9% higher performance or 18% lower power vs 18A), but profitable yields are reportedly not expected until late 2026 or early 2027. Q1 2026 Intel Foundry generated only $174M in external customer revenue with large operating losses. HSBC raised PT to $200 citing long-term potential. Q2 2026 earnings due July 23.
items.why: Foundry良率延迟是英特尔最大不确定因素；Q2财报（7月23日）是转折点判断关键；期权：高隐含波动率提供 sell put 机会，但良率风险需设足够安全边距

items.title: Palantir PLTR: Nvidia Sovereign AI Partnership + US Army NGC2 Core Data Layer Win; Q1 US Commercial Revenue +133% YoY; Stock +14% Pre-Holiday
items.summary: Palantir launched a new engine to deploy NVIDIA Nemotron open models in sovereign/air-gapped US government environments. The US Army selected Palantir Foundry as the core data layer for its top-priority NGC2 modernization program. D.A. Davidson upgraded to Buy with $175 target. Q1 2026 US commercial revenue grew 133% YoY. PLTR rallied ~14% before July 4, 2026.
items.why: 政府+商业双轮驱动加速，AI平台定位强化；高估值意味着高隐含波动率，sell put 时需留足安全边距以应对政策风险

items.title: 小米 YU7 上市6个月交付超15万辆，为SU7同期2.3倍；2026年全年目标55万辆
items.summary: 雷军宣布，小米 YU7 上市6个月累计交付超15万辆，相当于SU7同期交付量的2.3倍，超出市场预期。小米2026年全年汽车交付目标设定为55万辆（同比约+34%，2025年实际约41万辆）。港股7月8日盘中小米（1810.HK）涨幅居恒指成分股前列。
items.why: YU7销量爆发强化小米汽车成长叙事，是1810.HK sell put策略的重要正面催化；汽车业务持续改善为持仓提供基本面支撑

items.title: Alphabet GOOGL: Gemini App Surpasses 750 Million Monthly Active Users; 2026 AI Capex Plan Reaches $175-185B
items.summary: Alphabet announced the Gemini AI app surpassed 750 million monthly active users. Alphabet plans to invest $175-185B in 2026 capex (vs $91.4B in 2025), funded by operating cash flow, debt, and equity issuances — the largest single-year AI infrastructure investment commitment in history. Annual revenue first crossed $400B in 2025.
items.why: 谷歌AI商业化全面提速；大规模资本支出是AI基础设施长期需求强信号，间接利好英伟达/SK海力士等持仓；GOOGL自身 sell put 基本面背景改善

items.title: Alibaba wins court reprieve from Pentagon lobbying ban tied to DoD blacklist
items.summary: A US federal judge granted Alibaba a 60-day reprieve from a lobbying ban after the Pentagon added Alibaba to the 1260H Chinese military companies list in June 2026, causing all 25+ registered lobbyists to drop the firm. The court will rule on constitutionality. Alibaba argues the restriction violates the First Amendment.
items.why: 阿里巴巴军事黑名单诉讼获临时缓冲，但60天内须等待最终裁决；若维持，将严重限制美国业务拓展，BABA/9988存在重大监管风险尾部，持仓须密切跟踪。

items.title: SK Hynix Launches Record $28B Nasdaq Listing as HBM Shortage Locks In AI Memory Lead
items.summary: SK Hynix officially kicked off its ~$28.13B Nasdaq IPO (ticker: SKHY), targeting July 10 trading start. 177.9M ADS priced at ~$158.14 each. If completed, this would be the largest US listing ever by a foreign company; proceeds earmarked for expanding HBM manufacturing capacity.
items.why: HBM全球市占率约60%的SK海力士纳斯达克挂牌，募资规模创外资企业美股IPO历史纪录；直接改变DRAM/HBM板块竞争格局，需关注美光与SK海力士相对估值变化。

items.title: Samsung Electronics shares fall as capex concerns outweigh strong Q2
items.summary: Samsung preliminary Q2 2026 operating profit surged ~19-fold to KRW 89.4 trillion (~$58.4B), beating consensus of KRW 87.3T. The result exceeds Samsung's cumulative 2023-2025 profits in a single quarter. Yet the stock fell 6.9% in Seoul on concerns about capex commitments and demand sustainability, triggering a global memory chip selloff.
items.why: 三星创历史最佳业绩却大跌6.9%，市场担忧AI内存需求见顶与资本开支过剩；连锁触发美光、闪迪同日大跌约7%，存储板块整体波动率飙升，期权保护成本上升。

items.title: Intel to lay off up to 20% of Intel Foundry workers
items.summary: Intel plans to cut up to 20% (10,000+) of Intel Foundry employees starting mid-July under CEO Lip-Bu Tan's refocus on engineering talent. Broader 2025-2026 restructuring has eliminated 25,000+ positions (from ~125K to under 100K). Ohio fab delayed to 2030; 18A process running in Arizona for Google AI workloads.
items.why: 英特尔Foundry大幅收缩，代工战略短期难追台积电；对英伟达/台积电构成相对利好，INTC仓位不宜积极加仓，需等待代工业务真正企稳信号。

items.title: Micron, SanDisk, and Western Digital Sink 7% as Samsung Earnings Spark a Memory Selloff
items.summary: Micron (MU), SanDisk (SNDK) and Western Digital each fell ~7% on July 7 as Samsung's record Q2 profit paradoxically triggered a memory selloff on demand sustainability fears. Micron, Samsung and SK Hynix are all now down 20%+ from recent highs. Micron's own Q3 FY2026 revenue was $41.46B (+346% YoY) with Q4 guidance of $50B.
items.why: 美光和闪迪基本面极强但短期超卖（Q3营收$41.5B，Q4指引$50B）；大跌或为sell put入场时机，但须先确认存储周期是否见顶，行业资本开支风险不可忽视。

items.title: 港股午评：恒指涨2.38% 科指涨4.34% 科网股普涨 阿里巴巴涨超8%
items.summary: 7月8日午间，港股科技股全线走强，恒生科技指数涨4.34%，恒生指数涨2.38%。阿里巴巴涨超8%，联想集团涨超9%，腾讯、美团、小米等均录得明显涨幅。分析师指超跌、AI重估、资金回流、政策托底四重因素共振推动。恒生科技PE约20倍，处历史分位23.6%低位。
items.why: 港股科技午间迎年内最强单日表现之一，持仓腾讯/阿里/美团/小米短期均显著正收益，隐含波动率或随之上升，可适时布局covered call落袋。

items.title: Beijing bolsters Hong Kong bond, gold trading in global yuan push
items.summary: Beijing and Hong Kong jointly announced measures: Southbound Bond Connect quota raised from CNY 500B to CNY 800B; RMB Business Facility doubled to CNY 500B; HK launched gold central clearing system and revived gold futures trading; national FX reserves to increase HK asset allocation proportion going forward.
items.why: 人民币国际化提速，南向债券通扩额60%、双倍RMB融资工具利好港股整体流动性；黄金结算枢纽建设直接利好老铺黄金等相关资产，亦强化港股作为离岸金融中心的长期吸引力。

items.title: Google Loses EU Court Appeal Over 4.1 Billion Euro Android Antitrust Fine
items.summary: The EU Court of Justice dismissed Google's final appeal against the 4.1B euro ($4.7B) Android antitrust fine on July 2, 2026, ending an 8-year legal battle. The court confirmed Google abused market dominance by requiring device makers to pre-install Search and Chrome to license the Play Store. The fine is now permanent; further third-party damages claims may follow.
items.why: 谷歌欧盟罚款最终落定（约$47亿现金出血），更大尾部风险是引发第三方竞争损害追偿；GOOGL监管风险溢价叠加美国DOJ反垄断诉讼，持仓须关注法律不确定性。

items.title: 快手可灵AI完成30亿美元融资，腾讯、阿里、百度罕见同台联投
items.summary: 快手旗下视频生成AI公司可灵AI（北京可灵智能）完成30亿美元外部融资，融前估值150亿美元、融后180亿美元，为全球视频生成AI领域有史以来最大单笔融资。腾讯、阿里巴巴、百度（BAT）史上首次共同参投同一项目。快手持股稀释至约68.33%，可灵继续并入快手报表。预计12个月内启动港股IPO。
items.why: 腾讯和阿里同时参投可灵AI证明中国头部互联网对视频AI赛道极高确信度；港股IPO计划有望带动科技板块AI估值重估，腾讯/阿里的战略收益将体现于未来财报。

items.title: Tencent Bought Back 465,000 Shares For HK$204.8 Million On July 6, HKEX Filing Shows
items.summary: Tencent repurchased 465,000 shares for HK$204.8M on July 6, per HKEX filing, marking the 32nd consecutive trading day of buybacks with 34.5151M shares accumulated total. Shareholders approved a mandate for up to ~912M shares (10% of total) at the May 2026 AGM.
items.why: 腾讯连续32日回购创历史持续纪录，累计逾3400万股；管理层高置信度支撑股价下行保护，对sell put策略极为有利。

items.title: 6月末我国外汇储备规模34163亿美元
items.summary: 国家外汇管理局7月7日公布：截至2026年6月末，中国外汇储备规模为34163亿美元，较5月末减少260亿美元（-0.75%）。主因美元指数上升及全球主要金融资产价格涨跌互现，汇率折算和资产价格变化综合导致规模小幅下降。
items.why: 外储小幅回落但仍处历史高位，美元强势阶段对南向资金流动影响有限；宏观整体稳健，对港股汇率风险影响中性。

items.title: 腾讯以港币约107亿元减持快手约15亿美元，股权降至9.37%，不再为大股东；快手股价跌10.4%
items.summary: 腾讯旗下子公司以HK$43.25/股出售约2.73亿快手股份（今年港股最大宗交易），套现约15亿美元，持股比例从15.68%降至9.37%，触发失去主要股东地位门槛，剩余股份90天禁售。快手随即暴跌10.4%。
items.why: 腾讯AI转型步伐加快（Q1资本支出319亿元同比+63%），套现成熟投资加速投入AI；快手短期流动性冲击明显，腾讯本身战略聚焦度提升，90天禁售解除后仍有减持风险需关注。

items.title: 英伟达官方否认Kyber NVL144延迟至2028年：芯片路线图完好，供应链股恐慌性下跌后修复
items.summary: SemiAnalysis 7月5-6日报告称英伟达Kyber NVL144机架系统因PCB正交背板制造难题延至2028年，导致Ibiden等PCB供应商暴跌。英伟达随即声明路线图完好，股价回升约1%，Goldman维持买入评级。
items.why: Nvidia路线图若无恙则供应链股前期超跌属过度反应；HBM/GPU供给持续紧张逻辑不变，但事件揭示下游制造复杂性已成新风险点，英伟达相关期权波动率阶段性走高。

items.title: 央行行长潘功胜：债券通南向通额度扩至8000亿元，将持续提高外汇储备在港资产配置比例
items.summary: 潘功胜7月7日在香港货币与固定收益峰会宣布，南向通年度额度由5000亿元提至8000亿元，纳入回购支持并扩展至港元/人民币债券及澳门市场；支持更多优质国企民企赴港上市及发债，加大外汇储备在港配置。
items.why: 央行政策性利好直接提升港股市场资金面和信心，对富途/盈透等港美股券商及赴港上市潜在受益公司估值均有正面推动；南向通扩容也拓宽内地资金配置港股通道。

items.title: Tesla Q2 2026 Deliveries +25% YoY to 480,126—Best Q2 Ever; Robotaxi Launches in Miami Without Safety Monitors; Q2 Earnings July 22
items.summary: Tesla delivered 480,126 vehicles in Q2 2026 (+25% YoY, best Q2 ever, beating consensus), energy deployment 13.5 GWh (+41% YoY). Tesla also expanded Robotaxi to Miami without a human safety monitor aboard—a first. Q2 financial results are scheduled for July 22 after market close.
items.why: 交付超预期叠加Robotaxi无安全员城市扩张，FSD商业化里程碑有望推动TSLA估值重估；7月22日财报前隐含波动率持续抬升，是执行sell put/covered call策略的窗口期。

items.title: 三星电子Q2 2026预披露：营业利润89.4万亿韩元（约584亿美元），同比增约19倍，但股价收跌6.9%
items.summary: 三星Q2营业利润89.4万亿韩元（约584亿美元），营收171万亿韩元，均大超预期，但股价因市场担忧AI资本支出可持续性而在首尔收跌约6.9%。此为三星有史以来最高单季度利润。
items.why: Samsung业绩爆发但股价跳水印证业绩兑现获利了结格局；AI存储需求峰值担忧蔓延至港股/A股半导体板块，SK海力士（HBM持仓）受牵连，需关注期权波动率抬升。

items.title: SK Hynix to Debut on Nasdaq July 10 via $29.4B ADR—Largest Foreign ADR Ever; Reference Price Cut ~$1B on HBM Oversupply Fears
items.summary: SK Hynix confirmed Nasdaq ADR (ticker: SKHY) listing for July 10, targeting ~$29.4B (surpassing Alibaba's 2014 $21.8B record), with BoA/Citi/Goldman/JPMorgan as underwriters. July 6 regulatory filing lowered the reference price and cut fundraising by ~$1B amid HBM oversupply concerns.
items.why: SK海力士ADR上市提供美股存储标的配置路径，参考价下调暗示机构对HBM供给预期趋保守；南方两倍做多SKHynix ETF持仓的隐含波动率料于7月10日前后大幅抬升，应审慎管理期权delta风险。

items.title: A股7月8日：三大指数集体重挫，上证跌1.37%、深证跌3.17%、创业板跌3.84%，科技/存储板块领跌
items.summary: 受三星业绩股价跳水及英伟达供应链担忧双重冲击，A股今日大幅下行，德明利、北京君正、江波龙等存储相关标的跌幅居前，半导体存储指数重创。
items.why: A股科技/消费赛道整体情绪受压，需评估持仓组合的beta风险；存储/半导体板块可观察是否有超跌反弹机会，结合sell put策略时机。

items.title: 港股7月7日收盘：恒生指数跌0.51%，恒生科技指数跌0.75%，半导体存储与医药板块领跌
items.summary: 港股延续谨慎震荡格局，恒生指数早盘低开后震荡收跌。半导体存储板块受三星预警拖累大幅下挫；荣昌生物、三生制药等医药股跌超6%。
items.why: 港股整体情绪偏弱，持仓核心标的（腾讯、美团、泡泡玛特等）短期受市场情绪压制；建议关注恒生科技ETF隐含波动率，评估sell put入场时机。

items.title: 中东局势趋缓：布伦特原油从3月峰值逾126美元大幅回落至约72美元，霍尔木兹海峡恢复通航
items.summary: 美以对伊朗军事行动曾使3月布伦特原油飙至逾126美元；随后随霍尔木兹海峡重开大幅回落，当前约72美元。但特朗普最新表态维持对伊强硬立场，地缘尾部风险仍存。美联储当前维持利率于3.5-3.75%。
items.why: 油价大幅回落缓解全球通胀压力，有利美联储评估降息时机；同时降低消费类持仓（餐饮/旅游等）的能源成本端压力，对海底捞、携程等标的偏正面。

items.title: Hyperscalers Raise 2026 AI Capex to ~$750B Combined; Meta Lifts Guidance to $125-145B; Spending Set to Top $1T in 2027
items.summary: Amazon (~$200B), Alphabet (~$175-185B), Meta ($125-145B) and Microsoft (~$120B) collectively commit ~$750B to AI infrastructure in 2026, up ~67% YoY. All hyperscalers report supply-constrained markets; spending is forecast to exceed $1T in 2027.
items.why: AI资本支出超预期是英伟达/SK海力士/美光等AI芯片持仓最直接的逻辑支撑；谷歌、Meta中长期广告变现效率也将随AI投入增强，利好组合核心科技敞口。

items.title: EU Top Court Upholds EUR 4.1B Android Antitrust Fine Against Alphabet; EU Opens New AI Competition Probe Into Google
items.summary: The ECJ issued a final ruling July 2 confirming the EUR 4.1B Android antitrust fine against Alphabet, pushing cumulative EU fines to nearly EUR 11B. The EU also opened a new probe into whether Google's AI practices distort competition for publishers and content creators.
items.why: 监管压力持续叠加（罚款+新调查），对Alphabet短期股价和广告收入构成压制；但GOOGL已从5月高点回调12%+，核心搜索+云业务护城河稳固，估值收缩后中长期仍具配置价值。

items.title: Micron (MU) FY Q3 Revenue $41.46B (+346% YoY), NAND +361%—Stock Drops ~5.7% From Record $1,255 High on Sell-the-News
items.summary: Micron fiscal Q3 2026 revenue $41.46B (vs. $35.43B consensus), NAND revenue +361% YoY to $9.9B with ~1/3 of NAND volume under long-term agreements. Despite blowout results, shares fell ~5.7% to ~$929 pre-market July 7 as investors sold from the all-time high of $1,255.
items.why: 美光超预期业绩后股价仍大幅回调，与三星相似的兑现卖出格局，暗示市场对存储周期见顶担忧升温；持有两倍做多美光产品头寸需警惕短期回调，评估减仓或买保护的必要性。

items.title: Palantir Wins US Army NGC2 Contract; Launches Nvidia-Palantir Sovereign AI Platform; Q1 Revenue +85% YoY, FY Guidance Raised to +71%
items.summary: US Army selected Palantir Foundry as core cloud data layer for NGC2 modernization. Palantir and Nvidia launched a joint platform for secure government AI workloads using Nvidia Nemotron models. Q1 2026 revenue $1.63B (+85% YoY); FY2026 guidance raised to +71% growth.
items.why: 美国政府/国防AI合同持续落地，与英伟达战略绑定深化护城河；PLTR年初至今虽跌约27%，但Q1超预期加上合同驱动逢低sell put可积累成本，等待Q2财报催化。

items.title: 宇树科技科创板IPO注册生效，104天审核创科创板最快纪录，人形机器人第一股即将挂牌
items.summary: 宇树科技（人形+四足机器人）于3月20日递交申请，7月2日获证监会批复，全程仅104天创科创板最快纪录。计划募资42.02亿元，对应估值约420亿元，预计7月中下旬正式挂牌，将成A股首只人形机器人纯标股。
items.why: 具身智能/机器人板块重大催化，宇树上市将带动相关ETF和概念股炒作；A股科技赛道重要里程碑事件，留意上市首日行情对机器人板块整体情绪的提振效应。

items.title: 6月美联储决议：维持利率3.5%-3.75%，点阵图9人赞成年内加息，新主席弃用前瞻指引
items.summary: 美联储6月会议维持联邦基金利率3.5%-3.75%不变，这是新主席Kevin Warsh主持的首次会议。点阵图显示9名官员支持年内至少加息一次，6人支持至少两次加息。Fed将2026年PCE通胀预测大幅上调至3.6%，同时宣布不再提供传统前瞻指引。
items.why: 美联储鹰派转向是港美股当前回调的核心宏观驱动力，高估值成长股（科技、AI）承压最重；利率预期上行也提升期权隐含波动率，对sell put策略短期有利，但须评估标的下行空间。

items.title: Stock Futures Mixed as Global Chip Stocks Sell Off
items.summary: Global semiconductor stocks continued their multi-session sell-off through July 6, with U.S. stock futures mixed amid AI valuation concerns and the Federal Reserve's increasingly hawkish stance under new Chair Kevin Warsh. The rout followed reports suggesting SK Hynix may slow HBM production expansion, triggering a cascade through Micron, Intel, and AMD.
items.why: 全球芯片板块持续承压，SK海力士、英伟达、美光等持仓估值均受压制；波动率上升令sell put期权金丰厚，但须警惕行权风险；A股北方华创等半导体龙头已有跌停。

items.title: PBOC Unveils New Measures to Cement Hong Kong's Yuan Hub Status
items.summary: People's Bank of China announced a package of measures on July 7 to expand the investment channel between Hong Kong's financial market and the mainland, and to enhance Hong Kong's role in promoting overseas use of the yuan.
items.why: 人民银行出手扩大互联互通渠道并巩固港元/人民币双枢纽地位，短期利好港股流动性与估值，也降低持仓港股标的的汇率风险。

items.title: 腾讯混元 Hy3 正式发布：295B 混合专家模型，Agent能力全面重构，带动股价单日大涨
items.summary: 腾讯混元Hy3于7月6日正式发布，采用295B参数混合专家架构（激活21B），最大上下文长度256K，在复杂推理、代码生成及AI Agent任务上较4月preview版本实现质的飞跃，已向WorkBuddy、CodeBuddy、微信、元宝等近50项业务开放接入。股价当日随之明显走强。
items.why: Hy3正式上线是腾讯AI战略的阶段性里程碑，Agent能力提升加速企业AI商业化变现，是中长期估值重估催化剂；短期股价大涨，持仓者可考虑评估covered call机会。

items.title: China, HK Stocks Fall on Property Woes, Slow Services Growth
items.summary: Shanghai Composite slid 1.26% to 3,990.2 and Shenzhen Component lost 1.24% to 15,225.1 on July 7, settling at their lowest levels in nearly a month. CSI 300 fell 1.03% as concerns over China's economic growth outlook continued to weigh on sentiment.
items.why: A股全线下跌创近月新低，经济增速忧虑叠加地产拖累，对消费与科技持仓形成负面情绪压力；市场波动率上行环境对sell put策略的期权金有利，但须评估标的价格下行风险。

items.title: EU Package Fee from 1 July 2026: New Customs Rules Hit Temu, Shein and Cross-Border E-Commerce
items.summary: From July 1, 2026, the EU levies a flat €3 fee per tariff classification on all e-commerce packages from third countries and simultaneously abolished the €150 customs exemption threshold. Temu is responding by accelerating fulfilment from European warehouses in Germany, France, the Netherlands, Spain, and Italy to avoid the new charges.
items.why: EU新关税规则对拼多多Temu欧洲业务形成直接成本压力，但本地仓策略部分对冲影响；EU是Temu全球化关键市场，需关注Q2-Q3欧洲GMV变化及毛利率影响，持PDD仓位的sell put策略需纳入此监管风险。

items.title: Tesla Q2 2026: Record 480K Deliveries (+25% YoY), Stock Still Drops 7%
items.summary: Tesla reported record Q2 2026 deliveries of 480,126 vehicles, up 25% YoY and beating consensus by 18%, yet the stock fell ~7% — one of its biggest single-day drops in a year. Investors cited margin uncertainty ahead of the July 22 earnings call and BYD's continued lead (557,090 BEVs in Q2, 77,000-unit margin over Tesla).
items.why: 特斯拉Q2交付超预期但市场已price in，股价大跌说明焦点已转向7/22财报利润率；持TSLA的sell put须评估财报前后隐含波动率骤升风险，考虑提前调整行权价或平仓。

items.title: NVIDIA Leverages Balance Sheet to Support AI Chip Purchases via New 'AI Compute Partner' Program
items.summary: On July 1, NVIDIA announced a strategic initiative to help emerging cloud service providers access high-demand AI chips by leveraging the company's balance sheet — effectively financing GPU acquisitions for smaller CSPs that face financial barriers. The move aims to expand the Blackwell and Rubin platform install base.
items.why: 英伟达通过资产负债表支持中小CSP获得GPU，意在扩大Rubin平台装机规模，巩固市场壁垒；短期对NVDA估值有支撑，但也增加潜在表外风险，关注下季财报对该计划规模的详细披露。

items.title: Tesla TSLA Stock Recovers Sharply as Miami Robotaxi Launch and FSD Optimism Lift Sentiment
items.summary: Tesla shares rebounded 6.7% to $419.77 on July 6 after the company launched its Robotaxi service in Miami — the first deployment outside Texas and California — covering 10–14 square miles in western Miami-Dade. Morgan Stanley forecasts the fleet reaching 1,500 vehicles by year-end and 30,000 by 2030, with expansion to Phoenix, Orlando, Tampa, and Las Vegas planned.
items.why: Miami Robotaxi是特斯拉商业扩张关键里程碑，带动股价单日反弹6.7%，部分修复Q2交付后的跌幅。若Robotaxi加速推进，有助重估AI/自动驾驶估值倍数；关注7/22财报中Robotaxi商业化披露，sell put需留意财报前隐含波动率骤升。

items.title: Alibaba, Tencent Join $2.8 Billion Funding for Kling AI
items.summary: Alibaba Group Holding and Tencent jointly participated in a $2.8 billion funding round for Kuaishou's Kling AI, one of China's leading generative video AI platforms, valuing it at approximately $15 billion pre-money. The deal signals major Chinese tech incumbents are consolidating their bets on AI video generation.
items.why: 阿里、腾讯共同押注AI视频赛道，说明两者在大模型之外积极布局AI应用层，有利于持续AI叙事下的估值支撑；同时反映中国AI生态产业整合加速，关注后续各自AI收入贡献披露。

items.title: Hang Seng Index Opens Lower as IPO Slumps; PBOC Pledges Support for HK's Financial Markets
items.summary: Hong Kong's Hang Seng Index slipped to 23,568 at the open on July 7 while the Hang Seng Tech Index fell 0.4%. A disappointing IPO debut — Beijing Tong Ren Tang Healthcare opened more than 13% below its IPO price — weighed on market sentiment. Tencent bucked the broader decline, rising more than 1% in early trading.
items.why: 港股科技指数承压但腾讯逆势上行（受Hy3发布驱动），新股破发加剧整体情绪疲软；持港股标的sell put时隐含波动率上升对期权金有利，但须评估标的个股分化。

items.title: Tencent officially launches HunYuan Hy3: 295B-param MoE model, 90% agent task resolution, integrated across ~50 products including WeChat and Yuanbao
items.summary: Tencent's Hunyuan team officially released Hy3 on July 6–7, 2026: a 295B-parameter (21B activated) Mixture-of-Experts reasoning model with 256K context. Benchmarks show 90% agent task resolution on WorkBuddy (up from 72% with the preview), surpassing DeepSeek V4 Pro and Qwen 3.7 Max on key evals. Pricing: 1 yuan/M input tokens, 4 yuan/M output tokens. Already integrated into WorkBuddy, CodeBuddy, Yuanbao, ima, QQ Browser and ~40 more products.
items.why: 腾讯正式跻身顶级推理模型阵营，混元Hy3性能基准超越DeepSeek V4 Pro；当天0700.HK股价上涨约5.6%至477港元附近，显示市场对腾讯AI商业化给予积极定价。对于持有腾讯期权仓位的投资者，隐含波动率短期可能偏高，covered call或宽跨式可考虑在本轮反弹高位操作。

items.title: Tesla (TSLA) surges +6.7% on July 6 to close at $419.77 as Miami Robotaxi launch boosts investor sentiment
items.summary: TSLA closed at $419.77 on July 6, up 6.7%, as investors digested the Miami Robotaxi launch — first unsupervised commercial deployment outside Texas. Morgan Stanley raised its Robotaxi fleet forecast to 1,500 vehicles by year-end and 30,000 by 2030. Miami deployment covers western/central Miami-Dade (excluding downtown), with Phoenix, Orlando, Tampa and Las Vegas expansions expected by year-end.
items.why: TSLA单日+6.7%，收于$419.77，短期Robotaxi催化剂清晰。对持有TSLA卖出看跌仓位的投资者：当前股价远离低执行价风险区，隐含波动率可能因消息驱动短暂走高，是滚动期权/平仓获利的窗口；需注意Morgan Stanley扩张预测是否已充分定价。

items.title: Gold retreats to ~$4,147/oz from 2-week highs as USD strengthens; Fed rate-hike risk caps precious metals upside
items.summary: Gold fell to approximately $4,147.94/oz on July 7, down ~0.4% from prior session and pulling back from 2-week highs. A firming US dollar and elevated probability of a Fed rate hike at the July 28–29 FOMC meeting are limiting upside. Gold remains up ~26% year-on-year but has dropped ~4% over the past month.
items.why: 黄金在4100-4200美元区间高位整理：美元走强+美联储加息风险压制金价，直接影响老铺黄金(6181.HK)的金价叙事。若金价跌破4000美元，古法金首饰需求可能受压，需关注老铺黄金下行风险；同时黄金高位回调对A股/港股黄金板块也有连带影响。

items.title: Micron (MU) gets bullish Wall Street boost: Jensen Huang calls MU an 'indispensable partner'; analysts raise targets after record Q3 FY2026
items.summary: Following Micron's record-breaking Q3 FY2026 (revenue $41.46B, net income $28.24B), Jensen Huang publicly endorsed Micron as a key partner for Nvidia's HBM roadmap. Multiple Wall Street analysts raised price targets in early July 2026. MU has advanced over 240% year-to-date, making it one of the best-performing S&P 500 stocks. Micron has signed 16 multiyear supply agreements with binding commitments.
items.why: 美光Q3创纪录业绩叠加Jensen背书，HBM/DRAM超级周期持续验证；对持有两倍做多美光ETF仓位者是直接利好；需注意240%涨幅已消化大量预期，财报披露期后隐含波动率可能收缩，covered call策略有望获取时间价值。

items.title: A股7月进入财报披露季：定价逻辑从「景气预期」转向「景气确认」，沪深300约4842点
items.summary: 随着7月正式开启，A股将进入Q2财报密集披露期。市场分析认为，投资者定价逻辑将从「景气预期」切换至「景气确认」：凡实际业绩不及预期的标的面临补跌压力，超预期个股则有望获得补涨。沪深300截至7月初约4842点，较近期高位有所回落。
items.why: A股财报季开启，持有消费+科技赛道的中长期仓位需注意业绩兑现风险：关注好未来(TAL)7月披露节点，以及拼多多/阿里等中概龙头Q2指引；卖出期权策略的标的若Q2业绩有不确定性，建议在财报前降低delta敞口或选择更虚值执行价。

items.title: Q2 2026 US earnings season kicks off this week: Major banks report July 11–15; S&P 500 total earnings expected +10% YoY
items.summary: PepsiCo opens the unofficial Q2 earnings season July 9, followed by Delta Air Lines July 10. Major financials week begins July 11 with Citi and Wells Fargo, Morgan Stanley July 14, JPMorgan Chase July 15. JPM consensus: ~$5.49 EPS on ~$48.7B revenue (+10.5% and +5.2% YoY respectively). S&P 500 broad Q2 earnings expected +10% YoY, with investment banking and trading franchises leading.
items.why: Q2财报季正式开幕：大型银行业绩将为市场定调，若业绩超预期叠加降息预期升温，科技+消费板块可能进一步走强，持有谷歌/英伟达等US标的卖出期权时隐含波动率需关注；财报高峰期（7月15日前后）建议避免在即将披露标的上建立新的裸卖期权仓位。

items.title: Intel 18A-P enters risk production at VLSI Symposium: 9% performance gain or 18% power reduction vs 18A; Apple, Nvidia, SoftBank as anchor customers
items.summary: Intel announced 18A-P entering risk production. 18A-P delivers 9% higher performance at iso-power or 18% lower power at iso-performance vs the base 18A node, alongside 20–40% improved thermal resistance. Nvidia, SoftBank, Google and the US government are named as partners and customers supporting the Intel Foundry roadmap.
items.why: Intel 18A-P进入风险量产，代工业务拐点确认信号：若英伟达、苹果实际流片成功，INTC代工估值重估可能落地；短期仍属「风险量产」阶段，距正式量产和盈利贡献尚需时日，建议以中长线持仓态度关注而非追涨。

items.title: Palantir launches NVIDIA Nemotron engine for US government: AIP + Foundry now deploys sovereign AI in air-gapped classified networks
items.summary: Palantir Technologies announced (June 29) an initiative with NVIDIA to deploy Nemotron open models within Palantir's AIP, Foundry, Ontology and Apollo platforms for US government agencies and critical infrastructure. The joint offering enables agencies to run and fine-tune AI in air-gapped and classified environments with full data sovereignty. The sovereign AI market is projected to reach $600B by 2030.
items.why: Palantir绑定Nvidia Nemotron进军主权AI，国防+政府合同护城河进一步加深；PLTR近期已获多项大型国防合同（美国陆军NGC2等），Nemotron合作增强可持续收入确定性；对于持有PLTR的投资者，政府AI合同规模化是长期估值支撑，短期可考虑在相对高位适度卖出covered call。

items.title: Trump renews IEEPA-style tariff investigations against China, EU, Japan, India and Taiwan — second-wave trade war risk rises
items.summary: The Trump administration has ordered new Section 301 / IEEPA-style investigations into major trading partners — China, EU, India, Japan and Taiwan — alleging excess manufacturing capacity. Potential additional tariffs could layer on top of existing levies. US-China trade has already fallen ~30% since the first tariff round; fresh measures risk disrupting supply chains further.
items.why: 新一轮关税调查威胁中美、中欧贸易链：对拼多多Temu出海（成本上升）、小米欧洲智能手机销售、海底捞海外扩张（特海国际）均有潜在负面影响；美国对台湾的调查可能波及台积电供应链，间接影响英伟达/AMD供货时间表；卖出期权策略需在相关标的上保持更宽安全边际。

items.title: SK Hynix reportedly secures ~70% of Nvidia's HBM4 orders for Vera Rubin platform; HBM4 shortage expected to worsen in H2 2026
items.summary: SK Hynix has reportedly captured approximately 70% of Nvidia's HBM4 high-bandwidth memory orders for the Vera Rubin AI platform, outpacing Samsung and Micron in Nvidia's qualification process. SK Hynix has been shipping paid HBM4 samples to Nvidia since September 2025 with excellent yield rates, and the company warns HBM4 supply shortage will worsen through H2 2026 as demand surges.
items.why: SK海力士垄断约70% Nvidia Rubin HBM4订单，HBM4供给将持续偏紧：利好SK海力士H股（7709.HK），南方两倍做多SK海力士ETF（CSOP）持仓价值上升；HBM4短缺预期可能推高相关AI算力标的隐含波动率，包括英伟达期权。

items.title: Futu moomoo launches 'Moomoo Engine' (July 2): unified research + options + trading toolkit at $3.99/month
items.summary: Moomoo (Futu Holdings, FUTU) launched 'Moomoo Engine' on July 2, 2026 — a paid subscription ($3.99/month, $0.99/month for accounts >$1,000) bundling three engines: Fundamental Engine (7 research tools + AI briefings), Options Engine (Level 2 options data, strategy lab, P&L simulator, gamma exposure, unusual activity alerts, no-code algo trading), and Technical Engine (Level 3 order depth, volume profile, backtester, pro charts).
items.why: moomoo Engine的期权引擎（Level 2期权数据、策略实验室、盈亏模拟器、伽马敞口跟踪）与投资者sell put/covered call策略高度契合；富途Q1收入+25% YoY至7.47亿美元，客户资产同比+47%，Engine付费化有望提升ARPU；对于持有FUTU的投资者，产品货币化是估值重估的催化剂。

items.title: SpaceX (SPCX) officially joins Nasdaq-100 today (July 7); ~$4.3B passive buying estimated from ETF rebalancing
items.summary: Space Exploration Technologies Corp (SPCX) joins the Nasdaq-100 effective July 7, just 15 trading days after its June 12 IPO — the fastest-ever inclusion under Nasdaq's new fast-track rule. JPMorgan estimates ~$4.3B in forced buying from QQQ/QQQM and other index-tracking funds.
items.why: Nasdaq-100重组触发约43亿美元被动买盘，QQQ/QQQM等主要科技ETF被动增持SPCX；指数权重稀释可能小幅影响其他成分股（含英伟达、谷歌、特斯拉）估值，卖出期权前需关注隐波短期波动。

items.title: Nvidia banned Blackwell AI servers selling for $1.1M on China's black market — double official price amid US export ban
items.summary: Nvidia's DGX B300 servers, banned from export to China, are trading at ~8 million yuan ($1.1M) on China's gray market, up from ~4 million yuan ($550K). The RTX 6000 Pro has also tripled in price to ~130,000 yuan. Demand reflects intense unmet AI compute need despite US restrictions. Originally reported by the Financial Times (June 24).
items.why: NVDA出口管制下中国需求未减反增，黑市溢价验证AI算力持续短缺叙事；短期利好NVDA持仓，同时中美技术脱钩加速，有望推动国内AI算力替代进程（利好相关A股/H股）。

items.title: Disney Q3 FY2026: Experiences revenue hits record $10.0B; streaming income soars +88% to $582M; net profit -6%; CEO Josh D'Amaro's first report
items.summary: Disney fiscal Q3 2026 (reported July 7): Experiences division delivered record quarterly revenue of $10.0B. Disney+/Hulu revenue rose 13% to $5.49B with operating income +88% to $582M (first 10%+ margin for streaming). Net profit $2.48B, down 6% YoY. Company warned of possible US consumer slowdown ahead.
items.why: DIS持仓直接受益：公园创纪录、流媒体首破双位数利润率，但净利下降6%且美国消费放缓警告带来下行风险；新CEO首报偏正面，但sell put策略需评估后续指引与隐波。

items.title: Interactive Brokers June 2026: DARTs +53% YoY to 5.27M, client equity +40% to $930.3B, margin loans +67% YoY
items.summary: Interactive Brokers reported June 2026 metrics: 5.269M Daily Average Revenue Trades (+53% YoY, +6% MoM), ending client equity $930.3B (+40% YoY), margin loan balances $108.5B (+67% YoY), and 5.185M client accounts (+34% YoY). Average commission $2.52 per cleared order.
items.why: 盈透证券IBKR业务数据全面加速，DARTs+53%与保证金贷款+67%均显著超越大盘增速；期权交易量强劲，直接利好IBKR持仓；市场杠杆快速上升需关注回调时系统性风险。

items.title: Kioxia and SanDisk (SNDK) begin mass production of 10th-generation 3D NAND flash memory at Kitakami, Japan
items.summary: SanDisk and Kioxia have started mass production of 10th-generation 3D NAND flash memory at the Fab2 facility in Kitakami, Japan. The expansion significantly increases capacity for enterprise AI servers, cloud infrastructure, and data-intensive applications.
items.why: 闪迪SNDK启动第10代3D NAND量产，直接强化AI存储市场供应能力，利于维持高毛利；年内股价已涨约490%，新产能上线降低供应风险；Bernstein目标价3000美元可能进一步上调。

items.title: US stocks July 6 close at all-time highs: S&P 500 +0.72% to 7,537; Dow Jones 53,055; Nasdaq +1.12% to 26,121
items.summary: US equities closed at fresh records on July 6. S&P 500: 7,537.43 (+0.72%), Dow Jones: 53,055.91 (+0.71%), Nasdaq Composite: 26,121.16 (+1.12%). State Street Technology Select Sector SPDR added nearly 2%. Hang Seng also closed +1.3% to 23,350.
items.why: 美股三指数续创历史新高，持仓估值整体受益；科技板块强势带动，英伟达/谷歌/特斯拉等持仓正向影响；高位震荡格局下sell put需注意下行保护与时间价值平衡。

items.title: Standard Chartered becomes first G-SIB to offer institutional USDC minting and redemption with Circle — launched in UAE/DIFC
items.summary: Standard Chartered and Circle announced July 2 that institutional clients can now mint and redeem USDC directly through Standard Chartered's onboarding, initially available via its DIFC (UAE) operations. Standard Chartered becomes the first global systemically important bank to offer such integrated stablecoin services, with plans to expand to more markets.
items.why: Circle CRCL里程碑级合作，全球首家G-SIB背书大幅提升USDC机构可信度；配合GENIUS Act合规叙事与BNY Mellon托管，Circle稳定币基础设施护城河持续加深，长线利好Circle持仓。

items.title: （存疑·待核）美联储6月连续第四次维持利率3.50%-3.75%，但5月PCE通胀再度走高；高盛认为7月加息概率约50%
items.summary: 美联储在新任主席沃什主持的6月FOMC会议上全票通过维持基准利率3.50%-3.75%不变——连续第四次暂停。然而5月PCE物价指数同比涨幅创2023年10月以来新高，核心PCE持续高于2%目标。据报道高盛认为7月加息概率约50%，点阵图显示近半数委员支持年内加息。具体PCE数字待BEA一级公告核对。
items.why: 加息预期升温是港股H1最差表现的根源，若7月真加息将进一步压制小米、腾讯等高成长港股估值；美国核心通胀再抬头对全部权益资产均形成再定价压力；sell put策略须确保行权价低于当前支撑区、并在财报季前控制总敞口。

items.title: Tesla FSD V14 Lite rolls out to Hardware 3 owners, stock surges >8% in best single day in over a year; Q2 deliveries seen below consensus at ~393K; earnings July 22
items.summary: Tesla shares surged over 8% to close at $411.84 — their best single-day performance in more than a year — driven by the rollout of Full Self-Driving V14 Lite to early-access Hardware 3 owners. On the delivery front, Baird projects Q2 deliveries of ~392,900 units, below street consensus, though Cantor sees Q2 energy storage beating at 15.7 GWh vs. 13.9 GWh consensus. Tesla is scheduled to report Q2 earnings on July 22, 2026 after market close. Cantor calls 2026 a 'transformational year' for Tesla's shift into autonomy, robotics and chips.
items.why: 特斯拉（持仓标的）FSD V14推出是自动驾驶商业化里程碑，可能触发新一轮估值重估；8%单日涨幅显著抬升隐含波动率，对已有sell put的持仓须审查行权价安全边际；7/22财报是Q2关键催化剂，交付低预期与储能超预期将形成复杂叙事，建议在财报前适当管理期权敞口。

items.title: 欧盟7月1日起正式取消150欧元以下跨境包裹免税，Temu欧洲本土备货仅约20%、面临成本骤升挑战
items.summary: 欧盟自2026年7月1日起正式取消150欧元以下跨境电商包裹免税政策（此前为de minimis exemption）。Temu欧洲本土备货比例仅约20%（远低于应对目标），物流模式已从空运（占比85%→2%）切换为船运以压缩关税成本至3-5%。拼多多(PDD)2025年净利润同比下降12%，Temu欧洲增速承压。
items.why: 欧盟免税取消是拼多多(PDD)面临的重大政策转折点，可能进一步压制2026年下半年Temu欧洲GMV增速；建议在业绩指引明朗前对PDD期权策略保持审慎，尤其避免短期裸卖put。

items.title: South Korea KFTC alleges Google abused Android app dominance via GVP exclusivity contracts; potential fine ~849B won (~$615M)
items.summary: Korea's Fair Trade Commission (KFTC) on July 1 formally alleged Google abused its dominant Android app market position by signing exclusivity-style GVP (Project Hug) contracts with 22 top game companies — incl. Activision Blizzard King, Riot Games — over 6.75 years to prevent them from leaving Google Play. Affected revenue ~$9.2B. Max fine could reach ~849B won (~$615M), or 6% of relevant revenue.
items.why: 谷歌(GOOGL)继欧盟DMA令后再遭韩国重磅监管指控，多国反垄断压力叠加或影响AI广告/分发生态估值，持GOOGL仓位需关注监管折价风险。

items.title: US June Nonfarm Payrolls miss at 57K vs 110K forecast; gold rallies 2% weekly to $4,182
items.summary: June US nonfarm payrolls rose just 57,000, weakest in four months and far below 110,000 consensus, sharply reducing bets on a September Fed rate hike (CME probability fell to 50%). Spot gold climbed to $4,182/oz for its first weekly gain since late May; the US dollar headed for its largest weekly drop since April.
items.why: 弱非农压制美联储加息预期，美元走软利好港股资金面；黄金回升直接利好老铺黄金；期权市场加息预期大幅降温，可考虑适当下移保护性put行权价。

items.title: 富途控股拟被证监会罚款18.5亿元 因非法跨境展业 ADR盘前跌逾39%
items.summary: 中国证监会2026年5月22日宣布，富途控股（FUTU）多个境内实体未获许可违规开展证券、基金及期货业务，拟罚款18.5亿元人民币，CEO李华拟被处个人罚款125万元；老虎证券同日拟被罚4.112亿元。消息导致富途美股ADR盘前跌逾39%。截至7月，整改及最终处罚结果仍未落定。7月富途moomoo AI功能在七个海外市场完成全球部署。
items.why: 监管处罚规模超预期（18.5亿元），对FUTU是重大经营风险；整改期间国内客户获客受限；moomoo海外若不受影响，中期可期恢复；已持仓需评估风险敞口，期权策略应设保守止损。
items.source: 中国证监会官网 / 新浪财经 / 证券时报

items.title: Micron Q3 FY2026 record: revenue ~$41.5B vs $35.8B estimate; Q4 guidance ~$50B crushes $43.6B consensus; HBM4 in high-volume production, full-year supply sold out
items.summary: Micron reported Q3 FY2026 record revenue of $41.46B vs. $35.84B estimate. Data center sales surged ~7x to $11.5B; cloud memory +300% to $13.77B. Q4 FY2026 guidance of ~$50B vs. analyst consensus of $43.58B. Management confirmed HBM4 entered high-volume production in Q2 2026 and the entire 2026 HBM supply is sold out with pricing agreed. Quarterly dividend of $0.15/share; record date is today, July 6, 2026.
items.why: 美光Q3/Q4超预期业绩是AI存储需求强劲的最强佐证，有力对冲Meta算力过剩担忧的恐慌情绪；HBM4量产巩固AI存储三强格局；今日为股息记录日，持有者可获0.15美元/股季度股息。芯片股本周可能出现超跌买入机会。

items.title: Tesla Q2 2026: 480,126 deliveries crushed estimates by 74K (+25% YoY), yet stock fell ~6.5%
items.summary: Tesla produced 451,758 and delivered 480,126 vehicles in Q2 2026, smashing Wall Street consensus of ~406K units. Model 3/Y accounted for 467,762 deliveries; energy storage hit 13.5 GWh. Despite the beat, stock dropped ~6.5% — prior 11% rally, US demand concerns, and margin questions weighed.
items.why: 交付大幅超预期但股价反跌，典型买预期卖事实；Robotaxi扩张带来高波动率，卖put需审慎选择行权价与到期日，等Q2财报（7月22日）后再评估。

items.title: Nvidia launches RAISE: revenue-sharing model finances AI cloud startups, 210,000 Grace Blackwell GPUs deployed
items.summary: Nvidia announced July 1 the RAISE program, backstopping GPU infrastructure builds by capital-constrained cloud operators in exchange for a recurring share of future cloud revenue. First partners Sharon AI and Firmus plan up to 210,000 GB300 Grace Blackwell GPUs. CFO Colette Kress detailed the model on the Nvidia blog.
items.why: RAISE是Nvidia从硬件销售商向AI基础设施平台运营商的战略延伸，打开长期经常性收入；同时增加资产负债表风险，期权市场IV可能因商业模式拓展而重新定价，持仓基本面更稳健。

items.title: Micron breaks ground on $9.3B Hiroshima HBM fab expansion backed by $4.8B Japanese government subsidy
items.summary: Micron held a July 4 groundbreaking ceremony in Higashi-Hiroshima for a major expansion targeting HBM and advanced memory production. Commercial shipments expected around summer 2028. Japan has committed roughly ¥775B (~$4.8B) in total subsidies to Micron to date.
items.why: 美光HBM产能大幅扩充锁定长期AI存储需求，2028年投产后将强化HBM4竞争地位；对美光持仓估值有长期正面支撑，亦印证HBM供给仍是AI基础设施瓶颈。

items.title: Palantir's Foundry selected as US Army NGC2 cloud data layer — Army's top modernization priority; Palantir-Nvidia Sovereign AI deal signed
items.summary: Palantir's Foundry platform was selected as the cloud data layer for the US Army's Next Generation Command and Control (NGC2), the Army's highest-priority modernization initiative. Within the architecture Palantir handles cloud data; Anduril's Lattice covers the tactical layer. Separately, Palantir and Nvidia announced a partnership deploying AI models in secure sovereign environments for US government and critical infrastructure. Q1 2026 revenue rose 85% YoY to $1.633B.
items.why: NGC2是美军最高优先级现代化项目，Foundry成数据骨干是Palantir政府业务护城河的最强体现；Nvidia Sovereign AI合作拓展商业边界；Q1 +85%增速强化卖put的基本面支撑。

items.title: U.S. June nonfarm payrolls rose just 57,000, far below 115,000 consensus; unemployment steady at 4.2%
items.summary: The Bureau of Labor Statistics reported June nonfarm payrolls of 57,000, well below the Dow Jones consensus of 115,000 and the prior month's downwardly-revised 129,000. Unemployment held at 4.2% as labor force participation dropped 0.3pp to 61.5%. Following the report, Fed rate-hike probability for October fell sharply, reinforcing a 'higher for longer but no more hikes' stance.
items.why: 就业数据大幅低于预期，进一步打压美联储加息预期（期货已基本排除今年加息），美元走弱、美债收益率下降；对sell put策略而言，波动率偏高背景下时间价值收入仍佳，但需关注经济下行风险。

items.title: Micron Q3 FY2026 record results: ~$33.5B revenue guidance, 81% gross margin; $0.15 dividend record date TODAY (July 6)
items.summary: Micron reported record Q3 FY2026 on June 24: ~$33.5B revenue guidance, 81% gross margin, >$19 EPS. HBM4 for Nvidia Vera Rubin is ramping at 2x the pace of HBM3E with better-than-expected yields. Board declared $0.15 quarterly dividend; record date is close of business July 6 (today), payable July 21. Micron also signed a multi-year AI infrastructure partnership with Anthropic as primary memory supplier.
items.why: 今日为美光分红登记日，持有者须在收盘前持股以获本期分红；$33.5B营收指引+HBM4良率超预期，Anthropic战略合作锁定长期需求，基本面强劲支撑MU卖put策略。

items.title: A股交易新规7月6日正式施行：主板ST股涨跌幅上限由5%提至10%，盘后固定价格交易扩至全A
items.summary: 沪深北交易所修订版交易规则今日正式落地，三大变化：主板ST/*ST股涨跌幅扩至10%、盘后固定价格交易（15:05–15:30）由科创板扩展至全部A股及ETF、基金收盘交易改为收盘集合竞价。超150只股票受影响。证监会同步拟建立储架发行制度，优化小额快速融资机制。
items.why: ST股弹性加大、盘后交易便利性提升，短期增加相关个股波动率；期权卖方需注意新规下结算价变化机制对持仓的影响。

items.title: Tesla Robotaxi expands to Miami — first unsupervised commercial deployment outside Texas (July 3)
items.summary: Tesla launched driverless ride-hailing in a 10-14 sq-mile zone in western Miami-Dade on July 3, marking its first autonomous commercial deployment outside Texas. The expansion tests camera-only FSD in tropical heat, sudden downpours, and intense glare — conditions at the center of an active NHTSA investigation into failure in degraded visibility.
items.why: Robotaxi地域扩展是特斯拉FSD变现路径的关键里程碑；但NHTSA摄像头雨天失效调查悬而未决，短期事件风险较高；卖put应注意行权价与Robotaxi催化剂时间的匹配。

items.title: Fed holds rates at 3.5-3.75% for 4th straight meeting; flags persistent inflation and Middle East supply risks
items.summary: The FOMC voted unanimously on June 17 to keep the fed funds target at 3.5-3.75%, its fourth consecutive hold. The statement flagged inflation still elevated partly due to Middle East-driven energy shocks, with productivity growth strong and the labour market in balance. Policy commentary explicitly pushes back on near-term rate-cut expectations.
items.why: Higher-for-longer延续，Sell Put期权premium维持高位；港股HKD挂钩美元，美国利率预期直接左右资金流向。

items.title: A股七大交易新规今日（7月6日）正式施行：主板ST股涨跌幅上限升至10%，盘后固定价格交易扩至全A股
items.summary: 沪深交易所新规今日起施行，主板风险警示股票（ST/*ST）涨跌幅限制由5%扩至10%；盘后固定价格交易适用范围由科创板扩展至全部A股和ETF；深交所同步在创业板引入做市商制度；上交所基金收盘阶段由连续竞价改为收盘集合竞价。
items.why: A股交易机制重大调整，ST股流动性和波动率将显著提升；做市商制度有利于创业板成交活跃度，直接影响持仓标的估值定价效率。

items.title: Samsung and SK hynix to build HBM packaging fabs in Chungcheong region as part of $252.5 bil. in total investment
items.summary: 韩国政府公布三星+SK海力士联合约392万亿韩元（约2525亿美元）半导体投资计划，三星出资140万亿韩元建HBM封装厂，SK海力士出资100万亿韩元建NAND及HBM先进封装中心。
items.why: 全球HBM供应链重大扩产，确认AI算力周期持续；SK海力士(7709.HK ETF)相关持仓受正面催化，但产能释放周期长达2-3年。

items.title: NVIDIA Kicks Off the Next Generation of AI With Rubin — Six New Chips, One Incredible AI Supercomputer
items.summary: 英伟达Vera Rubin平台正式量产并启动7月交付，首批客户为AWS、Google Cloud、微软、OCI。Rubin NVL144 CPX提供8 ExaFLOPS AI算力；相比Blackwell推理token成本降10倍、训练GPU数减4倍。
items.why: Rubin出货确认AI算力超级周期持续，NVDA护城河进一步加深；持仓逻辑强化，covered call行权价可适当上移。

items.title: 美联储7月28-29日FOMC会议前瞻：NFP爆冷后加息概率从30%降至20%，点阵图已删除2026年降息预期
items.summary: 美联储下次会议7月28-29日。6月NFP仅新增5.7万（预期11万），市场加息押注从30%降至20%；但点阵图未给出2026年降息路径，高利率格局延续。
items.why: 加息预期降温为组合提供一定支撑；但降息遥遥无期意味着高估值成长股折现率压力持续，sell put时需关注隐含波动率是否已反映此预期。

items.title: June jobs report: US payrolls rose by 57,000, missing expectations
items.summary: 美国6月非农就业新增5.7万人，远低于预期的11万，失业率降至4.2%（因劳动力参与率下滑）；前两月数据合计下修7.4万。
items.why: 非农大幅不及预期，美联储7月加息预期显著降温，利好高估值成长股与黄金；隐含波动率可能波动，sell put策略前需重新评估隐含波动水平。

items.title: PHLX Semiconductor Index (SOX) down ~7% to open Q3 2026 amid AI stock rotation
items.summary: 费城半导体指数在Q2涨约40%后，Q3首周下跌近7%；Nasdaq整体受压，AI基建股高位减仓，部分资金轮换至防御板块。
items.why: SOX整体回调直接冲击英伟达、美光、闪迪、SK海力士、英特尔等多个半导体持仓；短期波动率上升，sell put需谨慎行权风险。

items.title: 快手可灵AI完成近30亿美元融资，估值180亿美元，腾讯、阿里云、百度史上首次联合入股
items.summary: 快手科技通过港交所公告确认，旗下视频生成大模型可灵AI完成独立外部增资，上限近30亿美元，融资后估值约180亿美元，创全球视频大模型单轮融资最高纪录。投资方涵盖腾讯、阿里云、百度（BAT首次联合）及CPE源峰、国方创新基金等。Q1 2026营收超65亿元（同比+300%+），ARR接近50亿美元。快手计划12个月内推进可灵AI赴港IPO。
items.why: 腾讯以战略投资者身份入局可灵AI，强化其视频AI生态布局，直接受益持仓；快手股价在此消息刺激下高开6%，可关注相关covered call机会。
items.source: 新浪财经 / 快手港交所公告

items.title: 美国6月非农就业仅增5.7万，远低预期11万；黄金突破4130美元，加息概率急降
items.summary: 美国劳工统计局公布，6月非农就业新增57,000人，大幅低于市场预期的约110,000人；失业率4.2%。4月与5月就业数据合计下修7.4万人。非农数据疲软令市场大幅压缩美联储年内加息预期，黄金现货突破4130美元。美股7月3日因独立日提前休市，本周交易日仅4天。
items.why: 宏观就业疲软降低加息风险，短期波动率环境偏有利于sell put策略；黄金反弹利好老铺黄金（6181.HK）正面情绪。

items.title: Tesla Q2 2026 deliveries: 480,126 vehicles (+25% YoY), smashes 406K consensus — first YoY growth in two years
items.summary: Tesla delivered 480,126 vehicles in Q2 2026, up 25% year-over-year and ~74,000 units above Wall Street's 406,000 consensus — the company's strongest Q2 ever and its first YoY delivery growth after two consecutive years of decline. Model 3/Y accounted for 467,762 units; energy storage reached 13.5 GWh (+40% YoY, slightly below the ~13.8 GWh estimate). BYD remains ahead in global BEV sales at 557,090 but Tesla narrowed the gap from ~220K to ~77K units. Q2 earnings call set for July 22.
items.why: 超预期交付将大幅提振Q2业绩预期，TSLA多头受益；7月22日财报前是期权策略关键节点，sell put者需提前评估行权价保护。

items.title: 韩国KOSPI重挫6.25%：三星-9%、SK海力士-14.57%领跌
items.summary: 7月2日亚市开盘，韩国KOSPI指数暴跌6.25%，三星电子大跌约9%，SK海力士（000660）单日跌14.57%，创近年最大单日跌幅。导火索为美股前夜半导体股全线崩跌以及AI资本开支前景不确定性。港股科技板块同步承压。
items.why: 持有SK海力士港股ETF（7709.HK / 南方两倍做多CSOP）；单日-14.57%触发风控关注，隐含波动率激增影响sell put策略。

items.title: 美股芯片股暴跌：Micron -8%、SanDisk -10%、Intel -9%、AMD -5%
items.summary: 美股周二科技股全线重挫，半导体板块领跌。美光（MU）大跌8%，闪迪（SNDK）跌逾10%，英特尔（INTC）下挫9%，AMD跌约5%，台积电ADR（TSM）跌6%。BofA泡沫风险指标达近年高位，市场忧虑AI资本开支降温、需求前景承压。
items.why: 持有MU/SNDK/INTC观察仓，半导体板块系统性重估；波动率急升影响sell put策略隐含波动率定价。

items.title: 阿里巴巴与DOJ达成$6亿和解：跨境商品标签违规
items.summary: 美国司法部（DOJ）宣布，阿里巴巴集团及其子公司AUS Merchant Services同意支付6亿美元，解决涉嫌在跨境电商交易中错误标注商品原产地、规避关税及海关申报的指控。这是针对阿里跨境业务的最大单笔监管和解。
items.why: 阿里巴巴（BABA/9988.HK）重大监管事件；$6亿罚款影响利润预期，需关注后续对Temu等同类跨境平台的示范效应。

items.title: Meta to offer excess AI compute as cloud service — Bloomberg
items.summary: Bloomberg reports Meta Platforms plans to rent out surplus AI computing capacity to enterprise customers, entering the cloud AI infrastructure market alongside AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud. The move signals Meta's data center buildout has outpaced its own model training needs.
items.why: Signals AI cloud competition intensification; relevant to watchlist 谷歌 (Google Cloud), and broader AI infrastructure re-rating narrative.

items.title: Circle CRCL -17.55%: Visa, Mastercard, Stripe, BlackRock, Coinbase launch Open USD stablecoin coalition
items.summary: Circle's stock (CRCL) plunged 17.55% after Visa, Mastercard, Stripe, BlackRock, and Coinbase jointly launched 'Open USD' — a competing stablecoin consortium designed to rival USDC. The move directly threatens Circle's core USDC franchise and market share in institutional stablecoin settlement.
items.why: Circle (CRCL) is a watchlist holding; -17.55% single-day move reflects direct competitive threat to USDC moat. Also relevant to 稳定币法案 (GENIUS Act) narrative.

items.title: Micron FY Q3 2026 record results: revenue $41.46B, net income $28.24B; HBM4 in HVM; $0.15 dividend
items.summary: Micron fiscal Q3 2026 (ended May 29) delivered record revenue $41.46B and GAAP net income $28.24B ($24.67/diluted share). HBM4 entered high-volume production in Q2 2026; entire CY2026 HBM supply sold out. Board declared $0.15/share quarterly dividend payable July 21 to shareholders of record July 6. HBM TAM CAGR projected at ~40% through 2028.
items.why: 美光创纪录财报验证AI存储超级周期；MU股息截止日7月6日（本周日），已持仓者注意除息；HBM4量产利好SK海力士（CSOP两倍做多ETF）；期权波动率财报后通常回落，关注下次财报布局。

items.title: S&P 500 & Nasdaq post best quarter since 2020; Philadelphia Semiconductor Index surges 87.8% in Q2 — record quarterly advance
items.summary: The S&P 500 rose 14.8% and the Nasdaq gained 21.4% in Q2 2026, their best quarterly gains since the pandemic rally of Q2 2020. The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index soared 87.8% in the quarter, its largest-ever quarterly advance, driven by the AI chip supercycle. Over 80% of S&P 500 companies beat earnings estimates in Q2, well above the long-run average of ~60%.
items.why: 美股创2020年以来最强季度，AI芯片板块领涨87.8%，港股科技股估值有望跟随修复；但季末大涨后隐含波动率可能回落，逢低布局sell put需关注7月初回调风险。

items.title: Tesla Q2 2026 delivery report due July 2: Wall Street consensus 406,024 vehicles; Goldman Sachs estimates 420,000
items.summary: Tesla is set to release Q2 2026 delivery figures on July 2. Wall Street consensus stands at 406,024 vehicles. Goldman Sachs analyst Mark Delaney estimates 420,000, citing solid recovery in Europe and China. Morgan Stanley raised its Q2 estimate to 413,000. For context, Q1 2026 left a ~50,000-unit inventory overhang. Tesla earnings follow on July 22.
items.why: 明日交付数据是TSLA近期最直接催化剂；若达420K+可触发多头追仓；持仓时可于7/22财报前布局covered call或观望sell put行权价位（TSLA当前约$370，YTD -17%）。

items.title: USTR proposes additional 12.5% Section 301 tariff on China in June; effective tariff rate on Chinese goods remains near 30%
items.summary: The US Trade Representative proposed a new 12.5% tariff on Chinese goods in June 2026 under a Section 301 forced-labor investigation. Combined with existing tariffs, the effective rate on many Chinese goods shipped to the US remains close to 30% — the highest of any trading partner. The tariffs amount to an average additional tax of $1,500 per US household in 2026.
items.why: 额外关税直接压制Temu/拼多多出海收益；港股出口相关标的估值受压；通胀预期上升使美联储降息时间后移，对全仓港股持仓产生多重负面：压制估值、抑制消费需求。

items.title: Tencent shares jumped ~10% after Bloomberg/CNBC reported WeChat AI agent 'Xiaowei' in consumer testing and enterprise 'Dayuan' rolling out on WeCom
items.summary: Tencent began testing 'Xiaowei', a native AI assistant within WeChat (consumer), allowing voice/text interaction with friends and mini-programs. The enterprise version 'Dayuan' — built on DeepSeek V4 — began rolling out on WeCom on June 23. Xiaowei uses Tencent's WeLM model, with DeepSeek for certain queries. Shares jumped most since late 2022 on the news. Public launch compliance process underway.
items.why: WeChat月活超13亿，AI原生接入若完成合规落地，将大幅提升变现潜力并催化估值重估；10%的股价反应显示市场已开始定价AI预期，腾讯(0700.HK)期权隐含波动率可能上升。
items.source: South China Morning Post / Bloomberg / CNBC

items.title: 阿里巴巴FY2026全年：云收入+34%至人民币1,581亿元，AI产品贡献云收入30%；总调整EBITA骤降56%，未来三年投入超550亿美元于AI基础设施
items.summary: 阿里云FY2026营收1,581亿元（同比+34%），调整后EBITA +35%至142.65亿元，AI相关产品贡献云收入约30%。然而集团整体调整后EBITA同比-56%至764亿元，自由现金流转为使用25.1亿美元，因大规模投入即时零售、用户获取及AI基础设施。公司宣布FY2026-FY2028间将投入逾550亿美元于AI与云数据中心。
items.why: 云+AI赛道高增长证明需求真实，但利润大幅下滑表明资本开支周期尚未进入收获期；自由现金流转负对分红/回购能力产生压制，sell put时需充分评估盈利能见度风险。

items.title: SK hynix ships HBM4E 12-layer samples (June 18): 16 Gbps/pin, 20% better power efficiency; UBS forecasts ~70% HBM4 market share for Nvidia Rubin
items.summary: SK hynix announced on June 18 that it has shipped HBM4E samples (12-layer) to major customers. Performance: maximum 16 Gbps per pin data speed and >20% power efficiency improvement vs HBM3E. Uses Advanced MR-MUF technology to achieve 48 GB in a 12-layer stack. UBS forecasts SK hynix will achieve ~70% HBM4 market share for Nvidia's next-generation Rubin platform. Nasdaq ADR listing (ticker SKHY) scheduled for around July 10.
items.why: HBM4E官方出货确认AI存储超级周期深化；CSOP南方两倍做多SK海力士ETF(7709.HK)直接受益；配合美光Q3+346%的营收数据，整体HBM供应商都有估值重估空间。

items.title: A股交易新规7月6日正式施行：主板ST股涨跌幅限制由5%调整为10%
items.summary: 沪深北三大交易所新规下周一起施行，主板风险警示股（*ST）日涨跌幅限制从5%放宽至10%，与普通主板股票一致；盘后固定价格交易与基金收盘交易机制同步优化。
items.why: 市场规则重大调整，ST股价格发现效率提升，单日信息消化加快；炒壳成本上升；涉及ST的ETF期权标的需关注波动率扩大风险。
items.source: 证券时报 / 每经网 / 新浪财经

items.title: Half-year Hong Kong stocks report: HSI drops 11%, Hang Seng Tech falls 19% — among worst globally; Trip.com -30%+ worst in index
items.summary: The Hang Seng Index declined 11% in H1 2026 while the Hang Seng Tech Index fell 19%, ranking Hong Kong among the worst-performing major markets globally. Key culprits: the Fed's hawkish pivot (from rate-cut mode to rate-hold/hike discussion) which compressed HK equity multiples, and the Hang Seng's lack of pure-play AI infrastructure names comparable to Nvidia. Trip.com plunged over 30%, making it the worst-performing constituent.
items.why: 港股整体板块承压直接冲击腾讯、阿里、美团、小米、携程等全部港股持仓；美联储鹰派转向是根源，若7月加息落地将进一步压制估值；sell put时须将行权价设定在充足安全垫以下，避免高贝塔港股持仓在宏观逆风中被逼仓。

items.title: SpaceX to join Nasdaq-100 on July 7 under fast-track framework — record fastest inclusion; JPMorgan estimates $4.3B in forced ETF buying
items.summary: SpaceX (SPCX) will officially join the Nasdaq-100 Index before trading begins on July 7, 2026, just 15 trading days after its June 12 IPO — setting a record as the fastest Nasdaq-100 inclusion in history under the exchange's new fast-track framework. J.P. Morgan estimates approximately $4.3 billion in forced buying from QQQ and other index-tracking products as sponsors rebalance. Over $800 billion tracks the Nasdaq-100.
items.why: 43亿美元被动资金流入将在7月6日收盘后开始买入SpaceX，纳指成份整体被动需求上升，利好持仓中追踪纳指标的（Palantir、英伟达、谷歌等）的流动性环境；同时科技指数权重集中度进一步上升，整体beta加大。

items.title: Micron Q3 FY2026: revenue $41.46B (+346% YoY), EPS $25.11 — both records; 16 take-or-pay deals lock $100B minimum revenue; HBM4 in HVM for Nvidia Rubin
items.summary: Micron reported fiscal Q3 2026 revenue of $41.46 billion (+346% YoY, beat by ~$6B vs. consensus), non-GAAP EPS $25.11 (beat $20.28 est.), adjusted operating margin 81.2%. Most structurally significant: 16 strategic take-or-pay customer agreements lock in approximately $100 billion in minimum contracted revenue and $22 billion in upfront cash — a structural break from the industry's historic boom-bust cycle. HBM4 entered high-volume production for Nvidia's Vera Rubin platform; HBM products remain fully booked through at least 2027.
items.why: 美光（持仓标的）财报大幅超预期，1000亿合同锁定收入大幅降低周期波动风险，为sell put提供强力基本面锚定；HBM4与Rubin绑定是长期价值护城河；闪迪(SNDK)和SK海力士同属存储赛道，受整体叙事支撑。隐含波动率财报后可能回落，sell put时机窗口。

items.title: SK Hynix plans Nasdaq ADR listing as early as July 10, targeting ~$29.65 billion; funds for HBM fab expansion and ASML EUV acquisition
items.summary: SK Hynix, the world's second-largest memory chipmaker and dominant HBM supplier (~60% market share), confirmed plans to list American Depositary Receipts on Nasdaq as early as July 10, 2026, targeting 17.79 million new shares and proceeds of ~45.5 trillion KRW (~$29.65 billion). Underwriters: BofA, Citi, Goldman Sachs, J.P. Morgan. Proceeds earmarked for new fab construction in South Korea and acquisition of ASML extreme ultraviolet scanners.
items.why: SK Hynix美股ADR上市将吸引大量美国机构投资者、大幅提升国际可见度，间接利好南方两倍做多SK海力士(7709.HK)等港股工具的估值重估；融资29.65亿用于HBM产能，长期保障英伟达Rubin平台供应链安全；本周有7/10上市事件驱动。

items.title: SanDisk (SNDK) jumps 11% July 1 as Bernstein raises target to $3,000 (+76%); NAND long-term contracts reshape supercycle thesis
items.summary: Bernstein raised SanDisk (SNDK) price target from $1,700 to $3,000 (June 30), maintaining Outperform. Thesis: structural shift to long-term NAND supply agreements (LTAs) with fixed/range-bound pricing, with ~$42B contracted through 2028. Base-case FY2027 EPS estimate $243. SNDK surged 11% on July 1, adding to its ~490% YTD gain — best performer in S&P 500 in 2026.
items.why: 闪迪(SNDK)Bernstein升目标价至$3000代表市场首次将LTA固定定价结构纳入估值，显著降低了NAND周期性下行风险；对持有SNDK或存储赛道的投资者是重要估值锚，sell put策略隐含波动率也可能因此收窄。

items.title: Tencent ramps up buybacks as share rout wipes out $309 billion: June repurchases top HK$9B — record monthly high for 2026
items.summary: Bloomberg reported June 30 that Tencent spent over HK$9 billion (~US$1.1B) on buybacks in June — set to be its largest monthly repurchase total in 2026 — buying back shares nearly every trading day since mid-May. Shareholders approved repurchase of up to ~912 million shares (10% of total) at May AGM. Shares have fallen ~$309B in market cap since October peak.
items.why: 腾讯大规模回购是EPS利好信号（10%股本回购授权），但$3090亿市值缩水凸显近期港股科技整体下行压力；对covered call策略需要重新评估行权价，sell put需提高审慎。

items.title: Dow closes above 52,000 for the first time as Alphabet joins index on debut day (+4.8%), replacing Verizon; marks best quarter for S&P 500/Nasdaq in six years
items.summary: The Dow Jones Industrial Average closed at a record 52,182.74 on June 29, 2026 — crossing 52,000 for the first time — boosted by Alphabet's debut day gain of ~4.8% as it replaced Verizon after 22 years. Alphabet is now the fifth Magnificent Seven mega-cap in the Dow (joining Nvidia, Amazon, Apple, Microsoft). Three tailwinds converged: Alphabet's index debut, a Supreme Court ruling protecting Fed independence, and easing US-Iran tensions. The S&P 500 and Nasdaq wrapped up their best quarter since 2020.
items.why: 谷歌（持仓标的）加入道指触发大量被动资金买入、首日大涨近5%，标普与纳指最强季度印证美股科技强势；道指创新高对持仓美股科技标的（英伟达、Palantir、特斯拉等）的市场情绪有正向溢出效应，隐含波动率短期有所压缩。

items.title: South Korea announces $518 billion semiconductor mega-plan: Samsung and SK Hynix each build two new fabs; HBM packaging plants in Chungcheong
items.summary: On June 29, South Korean President Lee Jae Myung, Samsung Chairman Lee Jae-yong, and SK Group Chairman Chey Tae-won jointly announced an 800 trillion won (~$518 billion) national semiconductor ecosystem project. Samsung and SK Hynix will each construct two new fabrication plants in South Korea's southwest near Gwangju. Samsung will additionally build HBM packaging facilities in the Chungcheong region to meet soaring AI demand. S&P said the accelerated Yongin investment is well within both companies' financial flexibility.
items.why: SK Hynix（持仓核心）国家级产能背书是最强政策红利：HBM长期供应保障、政府补贴降低资本成本；短期重大利好推高存储半导体板块情绪（美光、闪迪也受益）；但10年维度产能大幅扩张意味着未来HBM价格压力，sell put时须动态审视行权价。

items.title: （存疑·待核）阿里巴巴成立新AI部门Token Foundry整合核心研发；承诺未来三年投入3800亿人民币于AI与云基础设施
items.summary: 阿里巴巴成立新AI部门Token Foundry，将通义千问实验室（Tongyi Lab）与Future Life Lab合并整合，由CEO吴泳铭（Eddie Wu）领导统一AI研发战略。公司承诺未来三年内投入约3800亿人民币（约560亿美元）于AI与云基础设施，目标五年内将云+AI年收入做到1000亿美元。云智能集团AI相关产品营收已连续十个季度实现三位数增长。Token Foundry细节待公司官方披露核实。
items.why: 阿里（BABA/9988.HK持仓标的）3800亿人民币AI押注是明确战略转向，云AI十连季三位数增长是估值支柱；若Token Foundry整合顺利，将强化通义千问在大模型赛道竞争力；对sell put策略，BABA基本面改善降低了深度行权的尾部风险，可适度提高行权价。

items.title: Fed proposes new stablecoin oversight rules targeting Circle (CRCL); USDC market cap $78B; Circle H1 2026 revenue $1.25B, 95.5% from interest income
items.summary: The Federal Reserve proposed new oversight regulations for payment stablecoin issuers, directly targeting Circle Internet Group and its USDC token — following the landmark GENIUS Act which established mandatory reserve backing, federal licensing, and auditing standards. USDC now commands a $78 billion market cap. Circle reported H1 2026 revenue of $1.25 billion, with 95.5% derived from interest on short-term Treasury-backed reserves. Company market cap is ~$29.5 billion. BlackRock manages Circle's reserves; BNY Mellon handles custody.
items.why: Circle/CRCL（持仓标的）面临美联储新监管是双刃剑：监管明确长期利好机构采用USDC，但短期合规成本上升；H1营收12.5亿、95.5%来自国债利息意味若7月美联储加息，Circle财务直接受益；从期权策略角度，监管不确定性维持高隐含波动率，适合宽跨度sell put策略。

items.title: Intel 18A-P node enters initial production; preliminary Apple foundry deal reported; Alphabet and Nvidia also evaluating Intel as chip manufacturer; INTC +169% YTD
items.summary: Intel announced its 18A-P process node — an advanced performance variant of 18A — has entered initial production. WSJ/CNBC reported a preliminary agreement with Apple for Intel Foundry Services to manufacture some Apple Silicon chips (initial shipments not until Q2/Q3 2027). Reports of Google and Nvidia evaluating Intel as backup AI chip manufacturer triggered additional stock gains. Intel shares are up approximately 169% year-to-date, with the foundry turnaround thesis gaining broad validation from Apple, Alphabet, and Microsoft orders.

items.title: Bitcoin slides toward $58,000: June ETF outflows hit record $4.06B — largest monthly outflow in spot ETF history
items.summary: Bitcoin fell ~2% to ~$58,690 on July 1 as quarter-end pressure combined with record spot ETF outflows. US spot Bitcoin ETFs saw $4.06 billion in net outflows in June, the largest monthly outflow since the products launched. K33 notes 5-day net ETF flows were -34,267 BTC, the second-largest such stretch on record. Analysts warn no clear bottom yet confirmed.
items.why: 加密市场持续走弱是风险偏好收缩信号；Circle(CRCL)稳定币叙事赖以支撑的加密热度正在降温，同时BTC ETF流出规模创纪录也提示宏观避险情绪升温。
